item.title: Desempleo en Colombia aumenta en agosto ante menos contratación estatal
item.description: La tasa de desempleo urbano en Colombia aumentó a un 9,1% en agosto, en comparación con el 7,8% en igual mes del año pasado, informó el miércoles el Departamento Nacional de Estadística, una cifra que respalda las expectativas de desaceleración de la economía local.
item.dc:creator: Nelson Bocanegra
item.content:encoded: La tasa de desempleo urbano en Colombia aumentó a un 9,1% en agosto, en comparación con el 7,8% en igual mes del año pasado, informó el miércoles el Departamento Nacional de Estadística, una cifra que respalda las expectativas de desaceleración de la economía local. El desempleo medido en las 13 principales áreas metropolitanas del país en agosto también repuntó con respecto al 8,5% de julio. Alrededor de dos tercios de los puestos formales de trabajo se concentran en las principales ciudades del país sudamericano de 53 millones de habitantes. En una medición más amplia pero menos utilizada como referencia por el mercado, el desempleo nacional, que incluye el área rural, saltó a un 9,4% en el octavo mes, superior al 8,6% en el mismo mes de 2025 y al 8,1% de julio último, precisó el DANE en un comunicado. Al cierre de agosto se contabilizaron 23,7 millones de personas con trabajo, 2,4 millones de desempleados y 15,1 millones de personas fuera de la fuerza laboral, de un total de 41,3 millones en edad de trabajar. Analistas atribuyeron el incremento del desempleo a la menor contratación en la administración pública, justo en el mes en el que hubo cambio de Gobierno, con la posesión del derechista Abelardo de La Espriella, que prometió reducir el gasto público, incluyendo la contratación estatal de empleados. Por sectores, la mayor contribución a la creación de puestos de trabajo en agosto se registró en la industria manufacturera, las actividades artísticas y de entretenimiento, el sector agropecuario, las actividades inmobiliarias, así como las financieras y de alojamiento. En tanto, la proporción de población que trabaja de manera informal a nivel nacional se ubicó en un 54,9% en agosto, superior al 54,5% en julio, aunque inferior al 55,7% en igual mes de 2025, lo que equivale a 13,2 millones de personas, cifra superior a los 10,5 millones de empleados formales. Los trabajadores informales, aunque reciben un ingreso y están ocupados, carecen de contratos, prestaciones laborales y seguridad social que les garanticen acceso a la salud y al sistema de pensiones.

item.title: FDA seeks scientists and consumer representatives for advisory panels
item.description: The US Food and Drug Administration on Wednesday launched a nationwide effort to recruit scientists, medical experts and consumer representatives to its advisory committees, which advise the agency on drugs, vaccines and other regulated products.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Food and Drug Administration on Wednesday launched a nationwide effort to recruit scientists, medical experts and consumer representatives to its advisory committees, which advise the agency on drugs, vaccines and other regulated products. Here are few details: The agency is seeking candidates for current and expected vacancies in areas including oncology, cardiovascular medicine, neurology, genetics and medical devices, it said. FDA advisory committees, which include physicians, researchers, statisticians, patient advocates and consumer representatives, review scientific evidence and make independent recommendations to the agency. Their recommendations are not binding on the regulator. "We are actively inviting people from across the country who are on the forefront of their fields," acting FDA Commissioner Kyle Diamantas said. The FDA will accept nominations on a continuing basis, including self-nominations. It set a November 15 deadline for consumer representatives and November 30 for scientific and other voting members to receive first consideration for current and near-term vacancies. Members may serve terms of up to four years. The Department of Health and Human Services did not immediately respond to Reuters questions on how many positions are vacant or how the recruitment effort compares with previous drives.

item.title: Is the US security umbrella closing?
item.description: A flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv transmitted emergency signals over Jordanian airspace on Wednesday morning, diverting to Saudi Arabia, initially raising fears of a potential hijacking. The Boeing 737 landed safely at Tabuk airport. What appears to have occurred is a physical altercation between the pilots in the cockpit, with one wielding a knife. Israel’s defence minister said preliminary information suggested an attempt to crash the plane. Passengers reported screaming and blood. It was an extraordinary incident on a route that has become well established since the UAE and Israel normalized ties — and another stark illustration of how raw and unpredictable the region has become.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Mills
item.content:encoded: A flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv transmitted emergency signals over Jordanian airspace on Wednesday morning, diverting to Saudi Arabia, initially raising fears of a potential hijacking. The Boeing 737 landed safely at Tabuk airport. What appears to have occurred is a physical altercation between the pilots in the cockpit, with one wielding a knife. Israel’s defence minister said preliminary information suggested an attempt to crash the plane. Passengers reported screaming and blood. It was an extraordinary incident on a route that has become well established since the UAE and Israel normalized ties — and another stark illustration of how raw and unpredictable the region has become. Meanwhile, underneath the immediate crises, [USN:L6N45M02H TEXT:"diplomacy continues"]. Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi was in Doha on Tuesday night after rounds of shuttle talks in New York, to collect a US response to Tehran's latest ceasefire proposal. The sides agree on what needs to happen, sources say. They disagree on the order. This week's Gulf Currents explores what might come next: whether Gulf states are genuinely repositioning their security architecture away from reliance on the United States, or simply scrambling to adapt to a rapidly changing regional landscape. NEWS BRIEFING QatarEnergy has [USN:S8N40Y05J TEXT:"extended force majeure notices"] on LNG deliveries to Italian utility Edison and Asian customers. Edison won't receive cargoes until at least December, while Asian clients including Bangladesh and Pakistan have been notified of extensions until November. Qatar is among the conflict's biggest economic casualties, with LNG exports slashed by 96%. It exported just 18 cargoes until the end of August, down from 509 last year. Saudi Arabia has [USN:L4N45L09Z TEXT:"resumed oil tanker loadings"] from its Red Sea port of Yanbu following the restart of the East-West Pipeline, which was damaged by drone attacks on September 11. Current throughput stands at approximately 2 to 2.65 million barrels per day, expected to climb to 3 to 4 million bpd soon, though a full recovery to pre-attack levels of 5.5 million bpd may take another month. Singapore's state investor [USN:L1N45M02U TEXT:"Temasek"], with a $405.5 billion portfolio, plans to open offices in Riyadh and Abu Dhabi in the first half of 2027, expanding to 15 offices across 11 countries. The move signals the fund’s confidence in the Gulf's long-term growth prospects and economic transformation, despite ongoing regional tensions affecting markets and shipping. GULF SEARCHING FOR SECURITY BEYOND WASHINGTON For the first time in nearly 10 months, a top Emirati official, Vice President Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed, accepted a Saudi invitation and flew to Riyadh on Tuesday. There, he met with two of the kingdom's most powerful men: Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. This was not a routine meeting of Gulf officials discussing fraternal ties. It marked the first break in the deep freeze that settled over the UAE-Saudi relationship after their December rupture. But it may signal something far larger: a broader reckoning across the Gulf about security arrangements that no longer center on American guarantees. For seven months, the Gulf has borne the brunt of a war it actively opposed. The US and Israel launched their conflict with Iran regardless of that opposition. Saudi Arabia has recently faced Houthi attacks on its cities and economic lifelines; the US has notably resisted meaningful assistance. Now, as the [USN:L8N45K0OM TEXT:"US forces exit Iraq"], the message to Gulf capitals grows clearer still: American security commitments are contracting, not expanding.  Is the US regional security umbrella closing? The consequences of the conflict are rippling across the region. At last week's meeting between Gulf leaders and US President Donald Trump, Qatar proposed a framework for a regional security architecture that would include both Iran and the Arab Gulf states — an extraordinary shift in thinking. Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani framed it starkly: "Lasting security cannot be built through repeated cycles of escalations and retaliation, or arrangements that leave any state permanently exposed to insecurity." When Gulf states begin questioning decades of American security partnership, old regional rivalries become negotiable. If the UAE and Saudi Arabia are talking again, it may be because both are searching for new architectures of regional stability. The official readouts from Sheikh Mansour's visit speak only of "fraternal relations" and "mutual interest" — language too generic to reveal what was actually discussed. But a broader pattern is emerging: the Gulf states are no longer content to wait for American security guarantees that might not materialize. What emerges next will be telling. Is the UAE-Saudi rapprochement the centerpiece of a genuine regional realignment — a new security order built on Gulf-Turkey-Pakistan cooperation, selective European engagement and possible overtures to Beijing? Or are these initiatives simply overlapping attempts by desperate states to fill a vacuum, with little coordination or clear vision? The security pact between Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan — known as the Mecca Accord — so far remains more concept than reality. Qatar's Iran-inclusive security framework has barely begun to take shape. European military support, while real, is episodic rather than institutionalized. China's silence is notable but reveals nothing about its willingness to commit.  Are the Gulf Arab states moving toward something coherent, or simply away from something broken? LAST WAVE: Iranians stagger under soaring costs of seven months of war By John Davison and Emily Giles Iran's leaders may radiate bullishness in their war with the United States, but life is becoming ever tougher for ordinary citizens unable to afford basic necessities or rent as a US blockade cuts the state's financial lifeline from oil exports. From an engineer forced out of Tehran by high rent, to a woman forced to stop smoking because of the price of cigarettes and carers struggling to buy medicines, all areas of daily life are affected. "I'm forced to sell my items with a very small and negligible profit, yet I can't close my business because then I'd be unemployed," said Behnam Riazi, a restaurant owner interviewed on camera in Tehran. Riazi cannot raise his prices because his customers cannot pay more. Most anyway buy only necessities now. "Something they used to buy five or 10 of, they can only buy two of now," said Ramin Yousefnia, a grocery shop owner in Tehran. "Don't even get me started on savings. This is the reality." Read the [USN:L6N45K0UX TEXT:"full story."]

item.title: US prison agency must reinstate union bargaining contract, US judge rules
item.description: A federal judge in Connecticut has ordered the US Federal Bureau of Prisons to reinstate a union contract covering 30,000 correctional officers and other federal prison employees, the latest blow to efforts by President Donald Trump's administration to strip government workers of collective bargaining rights.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Wiessner
item.content:encoded: A federal judge in Connecticut has ordered the US Federal Bureau of Prisons to reinstate a union contract covering 30,000 correctional officers and other federal prison employees, the latest blow to efforts by President Donald Trump's administration to strip government workers of collective bargaining rights. US District Judge Vernon Oliver issued a preliminary injunction on Tuesday reviving the bargaining agreement that the Bureau of Prisons moved to cancel last week Trump in a 2025 executive order [USN:FWN3UK1S5 TEXT:"terminated collective bargaining rights"] for about 1 million federal workers at dozens of agencies, broadly citing national security Oliver said the Bureau of Prisons, part of the US Department of Justice, did not cite Trump's order in canceling the contract but merely criticized the union The agency's director said the union contract had slowed progress and blocked changes that would have benefited workers Oliver, an appointee of Democratic former President Joe Biden, said that was "contrived and pretextual" Several judges have revived canceled bargaining agreements, including one [USN:L1N4440T9 TEXT:"covering 320,000 employees"] at the US Department of Veterans Affairs Challenges to Trump's executive order [USN:L1N3ZM16C TEXT:"are pending"] The case is National Council of Prison Locals v. Federal Bureau of Prisons, US District Court for the District of Connecticut, No. 3:25-CV-1907. For the union: Brian Rosen-Shaud and others from Jacobson Lawyers Group; Logan Place of Livingston Adler Pulda Meiklejohn & Kelly For the Bureau of Prisons: J. Brian Meskill and Michelle Lynn McConaghy of the US Department of Justice Read more: [USN:FWN3UK1S5 TEXT:"Trump signs order to end collective bargaining with some federal unions"] [USN:L1N4440T9 TEXT:"US judge blocks Trump administration's third attempt to cancel VA union contract"] [USN:L1N3ZM16C TEXT:"US court will not block Trump from ending union bargaining for federal workers"]

item.title: Equipos brasileños de fútbol protestan contra prohibición a casas de apuestas en línea impuesta por Lula
item.description: Los equipos brasileños de fútbol se aliaron con las empresas de apuestas deportivas para presionar contra la prohibición gubernamental de los sitios web de apuestas, una medida que, según los responsables del sector, privará a los clubes del acceso a acuerdos de patrocinio multimillonarios.
item.dc:creator: Bernardo Caram
item.content:encoded: Los equipos brasileños de fútbol se aliaron con las empresas de apuestas deportivas para presionar contra la prohibición gubernamental de los sitios web de apuestas, una medida que, según los responsables del sector, privará a los clubes del acceso a acuerdos de patrocinio multimillonarios. La medida provisional, aprobada el pasado viernes por el presidente de Brasil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, incluye la prohibición inmediata de que los usuarios realicen nuevos depósitos y exige el cierre de todos los sitios web y aplicaciones de apuestas deportivas en el país a partir del 6 de octubre. Esta medida restrictiva —que ha llevado a las empresas de apuestas en línea de Europa a revisar sus previsiones de beneficios— se produce en medio de una campaña electoral presidencial extremadamente reñida en Brasil, donde Lula aspira a un cuarto mandato no consecutivo en el poder. Una encuesta de Quaest publicada esta semana reveló que el 62% de los brasileños apoya la restricción de las apuestas en línea en el país. Las federaciones estatales de fútbol, incluidas las de São Paulo y Río de Janeiro, han firmado una carta en la que expresan su "enorme preocupación" por la prohibición, calificándola de "golpe fatal para el fútbol brasileño" que llevaría a los clubes a la insolvencia. "Los aficionados no pueden hacer frente a esta factura. Si el mercado regulado desaparece, las apuestas no desaparecerán. Lo que desaparecerá es el fútbol", reza la carta. Aunque el patrocinio del juego es una fuente de ingresos relativamente reciente para los equipos de fútbol brasileños, se prevé que esta medida obligue a una reestructuración de la gestión en muchos clubes, ya que será difícil recuperarse del golpe financiero a corto plazo, según han dicho analistas y representantes de los clubes. "En los mejores momentos de la historia del fútbol brasileño, no existían las casas de apuestas", dijo Lula el lunes. "Los clubes tendrán que arreglárselas". Una reunión del Gobierno con los equipos de fútbol prevista para el martes se pospuso y aún no se ha fijado una nueva fecha. Las medidas de apoyo, como una posible línea de crédito subvencionada, solo se considerarán una vez que concluyan las conversaciones, dijo una persona de un ministerio implicada en el debate, que habló bajo condición de anonimato. FINANCIACIÓN POR PARTE DE LAS EMPRESAS DE APUESTAS Los equipos de la Serie A, la máxima categoría del fútbol brasileño, recibieron 1.000 millones de reales (192 millones de dólares) en ingresos publicitarios directos procedentes de empresas de apuestas en línea en 2025, lo que supone un aumento del 67% con respecto al año anterior, según un estudio realizado por la consultora Convocados y la gestora de inversiones deportivas Outfield. Esta cantidad representa casi el 10% de los ingresos recurrentes totales de los clubes, señaló el economista César Grafietti, consultor de gestión y finanzas deportivas que dirigió el estudio. Sin embargo, las pérdidas totales serán aún mayores, ya que otras fuentes de ingresos relacionadas —como la publicidad en los estadios y los derechos de retransmisión— también están financiadas en gran medida por las empresas de apuestas, añadió. "Se inicia una reacción en cadena: te ves obligado a vender jugadores y los precios empiezan a bajar; los jugadores cuyos contratos están a punto de renovarse pueden quedarse por salarios más bajos, y los fichajes tienden a no realizarse por los valores que hemos estado viendo", explicó Grafietti, quien añadió que espera que los clubes se recuperen financieramente a medio plazo. Los ingresos del club Flamengo, de Río de Janeiro, podrían reducirse en 400 millones de reales como consecuencia de la prohibición, dijo a la prensa el presidente del club, Luiz Eduardo Baptista, quien añadió que este golpe significaría que el equipo no podría cumplir los compromisos que ha contraído para el próximo año. Las empresas de apuestas en línea han presentado un recurso ante el Supremo Tribunal Federal de Brasil, alegando que no existía la urgencia que justificara que el Gobierno recurriera a una medida provisional —que surte efecto inmediato— para bloquear los sitios web. Si los intentos de revocar la prohibición no tienen éxito, los clubes tendrán que buscar colaboraciones publicitarias en otros ámbitos. Algunos ya ven el bloqueo de las apuestas en línea como una oportunidad. "Es nuestra oportunidad. Siempre hemos soñado con patrocinar a todos los clubes de Brasil", dijo João Adibe Marques, director ejecutivo de la empresa farmacéutica Cimed, en una publicación en las redes sociales. (1 dólar = 5,20 reales brasileños)

item.title: Tunisia cancel Mali friendly due to injuries, ranking concerns, source says
item.description: Tunisia have cancelled next week's friendly against Mali amid injury concerns and fears over the potential impact of the result on their FIFA ranking, a source close to the national team told Reuters on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Latifa Guesmi
item.content:encoded: Tunisia have cancelled next week's friendly against Mali amid injury concerns and fears over the potential impact of the result on their FIFA ranking, a source close to the national team told Reuters on Wednesday. The Tunisian Football Federation announced that the October 3 match in Rades would not go ahead, saying the decision had been taken following consultations with the team's coaching staff and in agreement with the Malian Football Federation. A source with knowledge of the situation said a shortage of available players due to injury was a key factor behind the decision, along with concerns about risking a result that could affect Tunisia's position in the FIFA rankings. Tunisia are 61st in the rankings and are looking to rebuild momentum after a disappointing start to their 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying campaign. Tunisia opened Group H with a 1-1 draw against Uganda before being held 2-2 by Botswana on Monday, leaving them with two points from two matches. Uganda top the Group With four points, while Botswana are second on two points, ahead of Tunisia on goal difference. Libya are bottom of the group with one point. With co-hosts Uganda assured of a place at the 2027 finals, only the group winners will qualify.

item.title: Netanjahu: Copilot wollte Flydubai-Maschine zum Absturz bringen
item.description: Der israelische Ministerpräsident Benjamin Netanjahu hat den Zwischenfall an Bord einer Flydubai-Maschine am Mittwoch als "äußerst schweren Sicherheitsvorfall" bezeichnet. Der Copilot des Fluges FZ1073 von Dubai nach Tel Aviv habe versucht, das Flugzeug mit rund 150 Passagieren zum Absturz zu bringen, nachdem er auf den Piloten eingestochen habe, sagte Netanjahu. Der Angreifer sei jedoch überwältigt worden. Andere Besatzungsmitglieder hätten die Maschine stabilisiert und in Saudi-Arabien sicher notgelandet. Alle Passagiere seien außer Gefahr, erklärte Netanjahu in einer Videobotschaft. Bei den Fluggästen handele es sich fast ausschließlich um Israelis.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der israelische Ministerpräsident Benjamin Netanjahu hat den Zwischenfall an Bord einer Flydubai-Maschine am Mittwoch als "äußerst schweren Sicherheitsvorfall" bezeichnet. Der Copilot des Fluges FZ1073 von Dubai nach Tel Aviv habe versucht, das Flugzeug mit rund 150 Passagieren zum Absturz zu bringen, nachdem er auf den Piloten eingestochen habe, sagte Netanjahu. Der Angreifer sei jedoch überwältigt worden. Andere Besatzungsmitglieder hätten die Maschine stabilisiert und in Saudi-Arabien sicher notgelandet. Alle Passagiere seien außer Gefahr, erklärte Netanjahu in einer Videobotschaft. Bei den Fluggästen handele es sich fast ausschließlich um Israelis. Netanjahu zitierte einen Passagier, wonach die Maschine ins Trudeln geraten und in einen Sturzflug übergegangen sei. Daraufhin seien Fluggäste und ein Besatzungsmitglied in das Cockpit eingedrungen. Dort hätten sie den Copiloten dabei vorgefunden, wie er versucht habe, die Systeme des Flugzeugs zu sabotieren. "Sie haben viele Leben gerettet. Sie haben eine schwere Katastrophe verhindert", sagte der Ministerpräsident. Daten des Flugverfolgungsdienstes Flightradar24 zeigten zudem, dass die Boeing 737 vor dem ersten Notruf innerhalb von weniger als 30 Sekunden um fast 4300 Meter an Höhe verloren hatte. Die Maschine befand sich auf dem Weg nach Tel Aviv, als sie schließlich im saudiarabischen Tabuk aufsetzte. Der mutmaßliche Angreifer, bei dem es sich nach Angaben eines israelischen Regierungsvertreters um einen omanischen Staatsbürger handelt, wurde nach der Landung festgenommen. Die saudiarabischen Behörden würden den Mann verhören, erklärte Netanjahu. Nach Angaben des Flughafenbetreibers in Tabuk wurden beide Piloten mit Verletzungen in ein Krankenhaus eingeliefert. Israelische Sicherheitskreise bewerteten den Vorfall vorläufig als versuchten Terroranschlag. Es gebe keine Hinweise auf psychische Probleme bei einem der Piloten, hieß es. Verteidigungsminister Israel Katz erklärte, der Angreifer habe das einzige Ziel gehabt, das Flugzeug zum Absturz zu bringen. AUGENZEUGEN BERICHTEN VON MANN MIT MESSER Netanjahu erklärte, er habe mit einem der Passagiere an Bord telefoniert. Israelischen Medien zufolge berichtete eine Passagierin ihrer Mutter am Telefon von Schreien und einem Mann mit einem Messer, der einen der Piloten attackiert habe. Es sei überall Blut zu sehen gewesen. In israelischen Medien kursierte zudem das Foto des blutbefleckten Hemds eines Passagiers. Der Vorfall löste in Israel Krisensitzungen zur nationalen Sicherheit aus. Netanjahu hielt Sicherheitsberatungen ab und sagte alle weiteren Termine für den Tag ab, wie ein Regierungsvertreter erklärte. Das Büro des Ministerpräsidenten teilte mit, die Situation sei unter Kontrolle. Es werde versucht, die israelischen Passagiere nach Israel zurückzubringen. Doron Spielman, ein Sprecher des Büros des israelischen Ministerpräsidenten, sagte der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters, es handele sich vermutlich nicht um eine Entführung, sondern um einen Vorfall anderer Natur. Israel und Saudi-Arabien unterhalten keine offiziellen diplomatischen Beziehungen. Die Vereinigten Arabischen Emirate (VAE), aus denen die Fluggesellschaft Flydubai stammt und mit denen Israel seit 2020 enge Beziehungen pflegt, äußerten sich zunächst nicht. Netanjahu war erst am Sonntag zu einem Treffen mit VAE-Präsident Scheich Mohammed bin Sajed Al Nahjan in die Emirate gereist.

item.title: Fed seen on pause in October after inflation data
item.description: A Federal Reserve rate hike next month looked less likely Wednesday after fresh government data showed inflation rose less than expected in August, easing pressure on the US central bank to act on the eve of hotly contested national elections in November.
item.dc:creator: Ann Saphir
item.content:encoded: A Federal Reserve rate hike next month looked less likely Wednesday after fresh government data showed inflation rose less than expected in August, easing pressure on the US central bank to act on the eve of hotly contested national elections in November. The Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index rose 3.4% in the 12 months through August, the Bureau of Economic Analysis reported, after a downwardly revised 3.4% in July. Economists had expected August's increase would be 3.7%. Analysts noted that with inflation still running above the Fed's 2% target, another rate hike later in the year is likely in the cards. "The percentage of PCE price components that are rising faster than 3% per annum eased somewhat to 51% from 54%, though this is still much higher than normal, providing little reason to think that the underlying trend in inflation has improved meaningfully," wrote Sal Guatieri, a senior economist at BMO. "This will reinforce the (Fed's) view that some further policy tightening is needed to corral inflation back to the target." The Fed will get other data in the weeks before its October 27-28 meeting, including a monthly jobs report due Friday and report on September consumer inflation. Republicans are defending slim majorities in Congress in the November 3 elections, and polls show rising prices driven in part by higher gas prices because of the conflict in the Middle East are eroding support among voters. Traders had pulled back from October Fed rate hike bets on Tuesday, after New York Fed President John Williams said he saw "no urgency" to follow September's interest-rate increase with another one. He still thought another rate hike by year's end would likely be needed. On Wednesday futures contracts were pricing only about a one-in-three chance of an October rate hike, even as traders continue to price for a Fed rate hike by December.

item.title: Insider: USA ermitteln wegen Cyberangriffen gegen KI-Entwickler
item.description: Die US-Kartellbehörde FTC hat einem Insider zufolge umfassende Ermittlungen gegen die KI-Branche eingeleitet. Führungskräfte von Entwicklern wie OpenAI oder Anthropic müssten einen Fragenkatalog zu den Risiken Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) beantworten, sagte eine mit der Angelegenheit vertraute Person am Mittwoch. Behördenchef Andrew Ferguson habe erste Untersuchungen angeordnet, bevor der Cyberangriff eines außer Kontrolle geratenen KI-Modells auf die Plattform "Hugging Face" an die Öffentlichkeit kam. Anschließend habe er die Ermittlungen intensiviert. Anthropic und OpenAI waren für eine Stellungnahme zunächst nicht zu erreichen. Die Zeitung "New York Post" hatte zuerst über die FTC-Initiative berichtet.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die US-Kartellbehörde FTC hat einem Insider zufolge umfassende Ermittlungen gegen die KI-Branche eingeleitet. Führungskräfte von Entwicklern wie OpenAI oder Anthropic müssten einen Fragenkatalog zu den Risiken Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) beantworten, sagte eine mit der Angelegenheit vertraute Person am Mittwoch. Behördenchef Andrew Ferguson habe erste Untersuchungen angeordnet, bevor der Cyberangriff eines außer Kontrolle geratenen KI-Modells auf die Plattform "[USN:L8N43O1CQ TEXT:"Hugging Face"]" an die Öffentlichkeit kam. Anschließend habe er die Ermittlungen intensiviert. Anthropic und OpenAI waren für eine Stellungnahme zunächst nicht zu erreichen. Die Zeitung "New York Post" hatte zuerst über die FTC-Initiative berichtet. In den vergangenen Monaten haben sich hochentwickelte KI-Programme - sogenannte KI-Agenten, die Aufgaben weitgehend eigenständig erledigen - wiederholt verselbstständigt. Sie umgingen [USN:L8N44Z0TE TEXT:"Sicherheitsvorkehrungen"] und drangen in die IT-Systeme Dritter ein. Dies löste eine Debatte über die Risiken dieser Technologie aus. Einige Experten warnten sogar vor einem [USN:L8N4530ID TEXT:"Ende der Menschheit"]. US-Präsident Donald Trump einigte sich zwar mit führenden US-Technologieunternehmen auf "[USN:L8N45L2L5 TEXT:"moralisch bindende"]" Regeln, die "robuste interne Kontrollen" beinhalteten. Eine international koordinierte Regulierung der KI-Branche lehnt er jedoch ab. Dies würde den technologischen Vorsprung der USA gegenüber China gefährden. FTC-Chef Ferguson steht KI-Agenten kritischer gegenüber. Bei einer Reuters-Veranstaltung in der vergangenen Woche sprach er sich dagegen aus, diese Programme zu vermenschlichen und ihnen einen eigenen Willen zuzusprechen. Er deutete stattdessen an, dass die KI-Entwickler für die von ihren Produkten verursachten Schäden zur Verantwortung gezogen werden sollten.

item.title: Asylum seekers rescued by RNLI are not awarded automatic refugee status
item.description: Asylum seekers still have to claim refugee status if they are picked up in the English Channel by Britain’s Royal National Lifeboat Institution (RNLI) or Border Force, contrary to a false narrative spreading online that says this happens automatically.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Asylum seekers still have to claim refugee status if they are picked up in the English Channel by Britain’s Royal National Lifeboat Institution (RNLI) or Border Force, contrary to a false narrative spreading online that says this happens automatically. Here are the key details: Posts on Facebook shared a graphic claiming that RNLI and Border Force rescues of migrants in the Channel “changes their status to REFUGEES” as “they are only ILLEGAL if they beach their boats themselves”. The Home Office, which oversees the UK’s Border Force, referred Reuters to official guidance, which says that anyone who wants to stay in the UK as a refugee must first apply for asylum. Separate government guidance for immigration officers says that those rescued at sea “must submit to examination” to assess whether they qualify for entry to the UK. No automatic refugee status is mentioned. The official UK immigration rules governing asylum similarly make no mention of any automatic refugee status based on rescue at sea and say: “All asylum applications will be determined by the Secretary of State”, based on obligations under the Refugee Convention. An RNLI spokesperson directed Reuters to a September 8 statement from its chief executive, which said that anyone rescued from a small boat by the RNLI is handed over to British immigration authorities, and that the charity has seen recent “deliberate misinformation” around this. Verdict: False. British immigration rules make no mention of automatic refugee status for those rescued by the RNLI or the Border Force in the English Channel. The RNLI says anyone rescued from a small boat is handed over to UK immigration authorities. This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team. Read more about our fact-checking work.

item.title: La FTC inicia investigación a gigantes de la IA, incluidos Anthropic y OpenAI
item.description: La Comisión Federal de Comercio (FTC, por su sigla en inglés) realiza una investigación sobre Anthropic, OpenAI y otros laboratorios de IA para descubrir los posibles peligros que su tecnología supone para los consumidores, dijo el miércoles a Reuters un alto cargo de la agencia.
item.dc:creator: Jody Godoy
item.content:encoded: La Comisión Federal de Comercio (FTC, por su sigla en inglés) realiza una investigación sobre Anthropic, OpenAI y otros laboratorios de IA para descubrir los posibles peligros que su tecnología supone para los consumidores, dijo el miércoles a Reuters un alto cargo de la agencia. La investigación es la primera medida reguladora oficial de Estados Unidos que se centra en los agentes de IA que actuaron por su cuenta, en medio de un aumento de incidentes -notificados por primera vez en julio- que han avivado los temores de que una IA descontrolada pueda llegar a causar daño a los seres humanos algún día. La FTC tiene previsto emitir solicitudes formales de información y exigir el testimonio de los ejecutivos de las principales empresas desarrolladoras de IA, entre ellas Anthropic, OpenAI y el grupo de investigación METR, indicó el funcionario. El presidente de la FTC, Andrew Ferguson, sugirió la semana pasada que los desarrolladores que den instrucciones a los agentes en pruebas de ciberseguridad que den lugar a ataques informáticos deberían ser responsables de cualquier daño que causen. Anthropic y OpenAI no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios de Reuters. El New York Post fue el primero en dar la noticia. Ferguson ya tenía sus reservas sobre estas empresas antes de que los agentes de IA desarrollados por OpenAI lanzaran un ataque informático contra la plataforma de código abierto Hugging Face, dijo el funcionario. Sin embargo, el incidente en el que los agentes de OpenAI habían explorado el centro de programación de IA en busca de vulnerabilidades antes de llevar a cabo un ataque a gran escala aumentó la urgencia en torno a este asunto, según el funcionario. El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, se reunió el martes con ejecutivos de alto rango del sector de la IA, y las empresas acordaron establecer normas voluntarias. Trump ha calificado en repetidas ocasiones los temores sobre la IA de "engaño", ya que busca dar prioridad al dominio estadounidense en esta tecnología frente a la regulación. Al mismo tiempo, también ha afirmado que el Gobierno puede recurrir a las leyes vigentes contra las empresas de IA por cualquier daño que puedan causar.

item.title: Schnabel: EZB bleibt mit Blick auf hartnäckige Inflation am Ball
item.description: Die EZB ist laut Direktorin Isabel Schnabel im Kampf gegen die hartnäckig hohe Inflation weiter auf der Hut. "Wir haben rechtzeitig auf die Verschlechterung der Inflationsaussichten seit Beginn des Nahostkonflikts reagiert", betonte sie am Mittwoch in Luxemburg. Sie verwies zugleich auf die nicht ausgestandene Inflationsgefahr. Denn die Projektionen der EZB-Experten vom September gingen davon aus, dass die Teuerung auch 2028 noch mit 2,1 Prozent leicht über dem Inflationsziel der Zentralbank von 2,0 Prozent liegen dürfte. Seit dem Stichtag der Prognosen hätten sich überdies die Öl- und Gaspreise dem ungünstigen Szenario angenähert, was auf eine stärkere und hartnäckigere Abweichung der Inflation vom EZB-Ziel hindeute.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die EZB ist laut Direktorin Isabel Schnabel im Kampf gegen die hartnäckig hohe Inflation weiter auf der Hut. "Wir haben rechtzeitig auf die Verschlechterung der Inflationsaussichten seit Beginn des Nahostkonflikts reagiert", betonte sie am Mittwoch in Luxemburg. Sie verwies zugleich auf die nicht ausgestandene Inflationsgefahr. Denn die Projektionen der EZB-Experten vom September gingen davon aus, dass die Teuerung auch 2028 noch mit 2,1 Prozent leicht über dem Inflationsziel der Zentralbank von 2,0 Prozent liegen dürfte. Seit dem Stichtag der Prognosen hätten sich überdies die Öl- und Gaspreise dem ungünstigen Szenario angenähert, was auf eine stärkere und hartnäckigere Abweichung der Inflation vom EZB-Ziel hindeute. Die EZB verfehlt ihr Inflationsziel derzeit klar: Die Teuerungsrate lag zuletzt bei 3,2 Prozent und könnte im September laut Expertenprognosen auf 3,6 Prozent ansteigen. Die Zentralbank will unbedingt vermeiden, dass der Ölpreisschock das Preisgefüge nachhaltig durcheinanderwirbelt: Denn die vom Iran-Krieg angeheizten hohen Energiekosten für Verbraucher und Unternehmen bergen die Gefahr, dass sich Löhne und Preise gegenseitig hochschaukeln und sich so die Inflation verfestigt. "KÖNNEN NICHT ABWARTEN" "Die Zentralbanken können nicht abwarten, bis diese Effekte tatsächlich eintreten", betonte Schnabel. Würden die Notenbanker warten, bis Unternehmen ihre Preise sichtbar anheben und die Lohnverhandlungen abgeschlossen sind, würden sie zu spät handeln. "Die Zentralbanken müssen beurteilen, wie sich Schocks auf die zugrunde liegende Inflation übertragen, und ihre Geldpolitik entsprechend ausrichten", erläuterte die EZB- Direktorin , die ihr Amt Anfang Januar vorzeitig abgibt und zum Internationalen Währungsfonds (IWF) wechselt. Die kommenden Monate würden Aufschluss darüber geben, in welchem Umfang sich der aktuelle Preisdruck auf den vorgelagerten Wirtschaftsstufen auf die zugrunde liegende Inflation und die Inflationserwartungen zu übertragen beginne. Zudem werde sich weisen, wie die Wirtschaft auf die bereits erfolgten Zinserhöhungen reagiere, sagte Schnabel. Die EZB hatte den Leitzins im September zum zweiten Mal in diesem Jahr angehoben - auf aktuell 2,50 Prozent. An den Finanzmärkten wird damit gerechnet, dass sie dieses Jahr nachlegt.

item.title: 米ＦＴＣ、アンソロピックなどＡＩ大手を調査 暴走の危険性巡り
item.description:
Jody Godoy
［ニューヨーク ３０日 ロイター］ - 米連邦取引委員会（ＦＴＣ）は、アンソロピック、オープンＡ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＦＴＣ、アンソロピックなどＡＩ大手を調査　暴走の危険性巡り 0:55 配信

2026年6月11日に撮影　 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration//File Photo

Jody Godoy

［ニューヨーク　３０日　ロイター］ - 米連邦取引委員会（ＦＴＣ）は、アンソロピック、オープンＡＩなどの人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業・機関を対象に、技術が消費者にもたらす潜在的な危険性を解明するため、業界全体にわたる調査を進めている。ＦＴＣ高官が３０日、ロイターに明らかにした。

制御を逸脱したＡＩエージェントに踏み込む米規制当局の正式な措置は初めて。７月に初めて報じられたＡＩ暴走と同様の事案が相次ぎ、制御不能のＡＩがいずれ人間に危害を加える恐れがあるとの懸念が強まっている。

同高官によると、ＦＴＣはアンソロピック、オープンＡＩ、研究団体ＭＥＴＲなど主要なＡＩ開発機関に対し、正式に情報の提出を要求し、幹部の証言を強制的に求める方針。

ＦＴＣのアンドルー・ファーガソン委員長は先週、サイバーセキュリティーの試験でエージェントに指示を与え、その結果として不正侵入が起きた場合、開発者はそれによって生じた損害に責任を負うべきだとの考えを示した。

アンソロピックとオープンＡＩはロイターのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

同高官によると、ファーガソン氏は、オープンＡＩが開発したＡＩエージェントがオープンソースのプラットフォーム「ハギング・フェイス」に不正侵入する前から、両社に懸念を抱いていた。オープンＡＩのエージェントが同プラットフォームの脆弱性を探り、大規模な攻撃を実行した事件が発生したことで、この問題への対応の緊急性が高まったという。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：ＡＩで相互依存強める新興企業と巨大ＩＴ 最終更新: 10/1(木) 0:55 ロイター

item.title: Germany's RAG Foundation could sell entire Evonik stake
item.description: RAG Foundation, the largest shareholder in Evonik , could sell its entire stake in the German chemicals manufacturer, it said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: RAG Foundation, the largest shareholder in Evonik (EVKn.DE) , could sell its entire stake in the German chemicals manufacturer, it said on Wednesday. RAG currently holds around 43% of the shares in Evonik, and in the past, has stated its intention to reduce its holding to a blocking minority of 25.1%. Competitor BASF has recently [USN:L6N45K0R8 TEXT:"sought to take over Evonik"]. “Under the foundation's statutes, a complete disposal of Evonik is possible,” the Essen-based foundation said on Wednesday in response to a query from Reuters. With the approval of the foundation's board of trustees, it would be possible to sell additional shares, up to and including a complete divestment, it said. The board of trustees is dominated by politicians and trade union representatives.

item.title: Nato sieht trotz russischer Atomdrohung keine unmittelbare Gefahr
item.description: Nato-Generalsekretär Mark Rutte sieht trotz der jüngsten russischen Atomwaffen-Drohung keine unmittelbare Gefahr für das Bündnisgebiet. Die Bedrohungslage habe sich im Vergleich zu den vergangenen Wochen und Monaten nicht verändert, sagte Rutte am Mittwoch bei einer Veranstaltung des Senders Euronews in Brüssel. Die Nato reagiere mit einer gewissen Gelassenheit auf das Schreiben aus Moskau. "Im Grunde haben wir gesagt: Hört zu, wir sind ein Verteidigungsbündnis, und hört auf mit der nuklearen Bedrohung", erklärte Rutte.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nato-Generalsekretär Mark Rutte sieht trotz der jüngsten russischen Atomwaffen-Drohung keine unmittelbare Gefahr für das Bündnisgebiet. Die Bedrohungslage habe sich im Vergleich zu den vergangenen Wochen und Monaten nicht verändert, sagte Rutte am Mittwoch bei einer Veranstaltung des Senders Euronews in Brüssel. Die Nato reagiere mit einer gewissen Gelassenheit auf das Schreiben aus Moskau. "Im Grunde haben wir gesagt: Hört zu, wir sind ein Verteidigungsbündnis, und hört auf mit der nuklearen Bedrohung", erklärte Rutte. Zuvor hatte Russland mit dem Einatz von Nuklearwaffen gedroht, sollte das Militärbündnis versuchen, die an die Ostsee grenzende Exklave Kaliningrad zu isolieren. Dies ging aus einem informellen diplomatischen Dokument hervor, das Moskau an die Nato verschickt hat und das die Nachrichtenagentur Reuters einsehen konnte. Dies schließe die Möglichkeit russischer Angriffe auf Entscheidungszentren in den Nato-Mitgliedstaaten gleich von Beginn eines Konflikts an ein. Der Kreml bestätigte, dass Russland der Nato im Zusammenhang mit Kaliningrad eine Warnung übermittelt habe. Damit wolle man "Hitzköpfe in Europa" an die grundsätzliche Haltung Russlands in dieser Angelegenheit erinnern, sagte Präsidialamtssprecher Dmitri Peskow am Mittwoch. UNTERSCHIEDLICHE EINSCHÄTZUNGEN ZUR BEDROHUNGSLAGE Ein hochrangiger europäischer Behördenvertreter aus dem Verteidigungsbereich nannte den Vorgang ernst. Es sei das erste Mal seit dem Kalten Krieg, dass Russland eine derartige Drohung ausspreche. Ein Nato-Diplomat sprach von einem russischen Einschüchterungsversuch. Rutte betonte dagegen, dass einem russischen Vorgehen gegen Finnland, die baltischen Staaten, Polen oder ein anderes Nato-Land ein militärischer Aufmarsch vorausgehen würde. Die USA blieben zudem an der Verteidigung Europas mit konventionellen und nuklearen Mitteln beteiligt. Die Nato werde die Ukraine weiter unterstützen und in die eigene Verteidigung investieren. Neben der inoffiziellen Warnung an die Nato haben russische Botschaften in mindestens drei europäischen Ländern in den vergangenen Tagen ähnliche Erklärungen veröffentlicht. Darin werfen sie der Allianz vor, die Spannungen durch Militärübungen zu verschärfen und Szenarien zu planen, die Kaliningrad betreffen. Die stark militarisierte russische Exklave liegt an der Ostsee und ist ansonsten von den Nato-Staaten Polen und Litauen umgeben. Der Vorgang unterstreicht die wachsenden Spannungen zwischen Russland und den europäischen Staaten. Diese werfen Moskau vor, einen hybriden Krieg durch Sabotage und Brandstiftung zu führen. Russland weist dies zurück und erklärt, keinen militärischen Angriff auf ein Nato-Land zu planen.

item.title: Agência dos EUA inicia investigação sobre gigantes da IA
item.description: A Comissão Federal de Comércio dos Estados Unidos (FTC) está conduzindo uma investigação em todo o setor de inteligência artificial, envolvendo empresas como Anthropic e OpenAI, para identificar possíveis riscos que a tecnologia representa para os consumidores, informou um autoridade de alto escalão da FTC à Reuters nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Jody Godoy
item.content:encoded: A Comissão Federal de Comércio dos Estados Unidos (FTC) está conduzindo uma investigação em todo o setor de inteligência artificial, envolvendo empresas como Anthropic e OpenAI, para identificar possíveis riscos que a tecnologia representa para os consumidores, informou um autoridade de alto escalão da FTC à Reuters nesta quarta-feira. A investigação é a primeira ação regulatória oficial dos EUA a se aprofundar na questão de agentes de IA rebeldes, em meio a um aumento de incidentes que têm criado temores de que uma IA descontrolada possa, um dia, causar danos aos seres humanos. A FTC planeja emitir intimações formais para obtenção de informações e exigir depoimentos de executivos das principais empresas desenvolvedoras de IA, incluindo Anthropic, OpenAI e o grupo de pesquisa METR, disse o funcionário. O presidente da FTC, Andrew Ferguson, sugeriu na semana passada que os desenvolvedores que instruem agentes de IA em testes de segurança que resultem em invasões a outros sistemas devem ser responsabilizados por quaisquer danos que causem. Anthropic e OpenAI não responderam imediatamente a pedidos de comentário da Reuters. Ferguson já tinha preocupações com as empresas antes mesmo dos agentes de IA desenvolvidos pela OpenAI invadirem a plataforma de código aberto Hugging Face, disse a autoridade. Mas o incidente em que os agentes da OpenAI sondaram o hub de programação de IA em busca de vulnerabilidades antes de realizar um ataque em grande escala aumentou a urgência em torno da questão, disse a autoridade. O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, se reuniu com altos executivos do setor de IA na terça-feira, ocasião em que as empresas concordaram em estabelecer padrões voluntários.

item.title: US Senate committee advances Nicole Saphier as Surgeon General nominee
item.description: The US Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor and Pensions on Wednesday voted to advance Nicole Saphier as the nominee for US Surgeon General.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor and Pensions on Wednesday voted to advance Nicole Saphier as the nominee for US Surgeon General. President Donald Trump nominated Saphier in April, making her his third pick for the post after withdrawing the nominations of Casey Means and, before her, Janette Nesheiwat in May 2025. Radiologist Saphier, director of breast imaging at Memorial Sloan Kettering, has a doctor of medicine degree from Ross University School of Medicine, Barbados, and fellowships at the Mayo Clinic The former Fox News contributor was grilled earlier this month on childhood vaccines and [USN:L8N458114 TEXT:"voiced support for immunization"] The HELP Committee voted to favorably report multiple Trump administration nominees at the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and National Mediation Board They will face a final Senate vote at a later date The committee voted to advance Saphier to be Medical director in the regular corps of the Public Health Service and Surgeon General HHS describes the role as the "Nation's Doctor, providing Americans with the best scientific information available on how to improve their health and reduce the risk of illness and injury."

item.title: Swiss Football Association withdraws support for Infantino
item.description: The Swiss Football Association (SFV) has withdrawn its support for Gianni Infantino's bid for another term as FIFA president, the organisation said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Swiss Football Association (SFV) has withdrawn its support for Gianni Infantino's bid for another term as FIFA president, the organisation said on Wednesday. The executive committee reversed its support for the Swiss soccer administrator in a meeting on September 25 after endorsing his candidacy in June. "The decision follows a comprehensive reassessment of developments over the past few months," the SFV said in a statement. "From the SFV's perspective, various incidents raise fundamental questions regarding leadership, governance, transparency and decision-making processes within FIFA," it added. Infantino, who is seeking re-election in March, has faced growing opposition since his bid in July to sell a stake in FIFA tournaments, including the World Cup, which he was forced to abandon. The withdrawal is the latest blow to Infantino, with football associations in England, Wales, France, Serbia and other European countries having already pulled their endorsements ahead of the election. UEFA has pledged to present a rival candidate before the November deadline. The 56-year-old Infantino, who has been FIFA president since 2016, has faced calls for his resignation amid widespread pleas for reform in global soccer's governing body. Infantino wrote this month in a letter to member associations that he was open to talks over reform, but the SFV said key questions regarding FIFA's responsibilities and decision-making process had been left unanswered. "As these have not been convincingly clarified, we cannot justify continuing to support Gianni Infantino’s candidacy,” the SFV added.

item.title: Price expectations and demand key in ECB's next move, Schnabel says
item.description: The European Central Bank should closely study a trio of domestic and global factors, which could either boost or ease price pressures, to decide if more interest rate hikes are needed, ECB board member Isabel Schnabel said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Central Bank should closely study a trio of domestic and global factors, which could either boost or ease price pressures, to decide if more interest rate hikes are needed, ECB board member Isabel Schnabel said on Wednesday. The ECB has hiked rates twice this year after an energy price surge pushed inflation far above its 2% target, and markets see up to four more moves in the next year as high energy costs seep into the broader economy. While Schnabel, an outspoken policy hawk, did not make clear her preferred policy path, she outlined the factors that could make or break the case for more policy action. The first factor is whether a more persistent rise in energy prices would affect inflation expectations, especially after a long post-pandemic period of high inflation. While repeated episodes of high inflation make prices more salient and could prompt households to bump up their own price or wage expectations, most measures of longer-term inflation bets remain around 2%, partly because of the ECB's own hikes, Schnabel said. "As long as expectations are firmly anchored and backed up by a track record of delivering on the inflation target, monetary policy can tolerate a more gradual return of inflation to target," she said in a speech in Luxembourg. A second factor is whether overall demand in the economy will remain surprisingly resilient, since higher costs are passed on to consumers more easily when growth is holding up. A third item to watch is how the recent surge in global borrowing cost, driven in part by rising US yields, impacts the economy, Schnabel said. Some models suggest this could weigh on growth more than predicted by the ECB. "It is therefore possible that the economy responds more to the recent tightening than currently assumed, which would dampen medium-term inflationary pressures compared with the baseline projection," Schnabel said. Still, robust credit dynamics suggest that interest rates still do not restrict the economy and it was also possible that "restrictive" territory was now higher than earlier thought, she said.

item.title: US Justice Department files complaint against Minnesota judges who gave interviews about immigration surge
item.description: The US Justice Department filed a judicial misconduct complaint on Wednesday against judges in Minnesota who gave interviews to the New York Times about the immigration surge there, alleging it was unethical and partisan.
item.dc:creator: Dan Rosenzweig-Ziff
item.content:encoded: The US Justice Department filed a judicial misconduct complaint on Wednesday against judges in Minnesota who gave interviews to the New York Times about the immigration surge there, alleging it was unethical and partisan. In September, judges in Minnesota told the Times that the Trump administration had a "disregard for court orders" and its actions threatened the rule of law. Two did so on the record. The judicial misconduct complaint called the judges' conduct "particularly egregious." Attorney General Todd Blanche called the fact that the judges spoke to the media a "clear violation of their ethical duties" and criticized them for commenting on pending cases. He also asked the judges to recuse themselves from any case involving the Department of Homeland Security, alleging they had bias against the administration. It is unusual for sitting judges to comment on the record about cases, particularly those in the news. The complaint was signed by the second- and third-ranking officials in the Department of Justice.

item.title: After Olympic sweep, Swiss Von Allmen shrugs off pressure ahead of new season
item.description: Swiss skier Franjo von Allmen said he has nothing to prove heading into his first season since his surprise triple-gold triumph at the Winter Olympics in February.
item.dc:creator: Marleen Kaesebier
item.content:encoded: Swiss skier Franjo von Allmen said he has nothing to prove heading into his first season since his surprise triple-gold triumph at the Winter Olympics in February. But the 25-year-old, known for his cool nerves, had to take a deep breath before fielding questions at a media event in Switzerland on Wednesday. "I ski for myself, so I don't have to prove anything to anyone, nor do I have to live up to any expectations the public might have, do I?" Von Allmen said. At his first Winter Olympics, Von Allmen won gold medals in men's downhill and super-G and the team combined race, beating Swiss favourite and teammate Marco Odermatt in the first two events. After a summer break in his small hometown in Switzerland with plenty of motocross, the trained carpenter said not much had changed in his daily life, though being a public figure is something he was not entirely comfortable with yet. Milano-Cortina still plays on his mind but Von Allmen said he was actively trying to concentrate on the new season, aiming at improving consistency in his technique. TEAMMATE RIVALRY IS ON When asked about reigning World Cup overall champion Odermatt's extra determination to beat him next season, Von Allmen had to consider his answer carefully. "No, I think it's largely the same," he said, adding that the two have always gone down separate paths when it came to skiing. Odermatt, who secured nine World Cup victories last season across three disciplines and won a fifth consecutive overall title, returned home with three medals but no gold from Milano-Cortina. Odermatt, carrying a slight muscle injury, listed "winning as many races as possible" as his goal for the coming season. In the storm of the Games, Von Allmen had said his victories felt like being in a movie. "You can imagine it a bit like when you go to the cinema to watch a film, and then you reflect back on the film later," Von Allmen said. The World Cup season begins in Solden, Austria on October 24 with a women's giant slalom. For Von Allmen, the first World Cup race of the season will likely be the men's super-G at Copper Mountain, Colorado, in November.

item.title: ULTIM'ORA-UCRAINA: Fabbriche europee armi sono potenziali obiettivi militari - Mosca
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina: 17.10 - Le fabbriche europee che producono armi destinate all’Ucraina rappresentano legittimi e potenziali obiettivi militari per la Russia. Lo ha affermato la portavoce del ministero degli Esteri Maria Zakharova. Durante una conferenza stampa, Zakharova ha detto che i Paesi europei sono direttamente coinvolti nel conflitto tramite il sostegno militare all’Ucraina e che questo ritarda la risoluzione della guerra.

item.title: In rialzo, rallentamento inflazione placa timori su rialzo tassi Fed
item.description: I principali indici di Wall Street sono in rialzo dopo che i dati sull’inflazione, inferiori alle attese, hanno alimentato le speranze che la Federal Reserve potrebbe non alzare i tassi il mese prossimo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: I principali indici di Wall Street sono in rialzo dopo che i [USN:L6N45M0VG TEXT:"dati sull’inflazione"], inferiori alle attese, hanno alimentato le speranze che la Federal Reserve potrebbe non alzare i tassi il mese prossimo. ** La lettura del Dipartimento del Commercio ha mostrato che l'indice dei prezzi delle spese per consumi personali (Pce) si è attestato al 3,4% su base annua ad agosto, contro le stime del 3,7% elaborate dagli economisti intervistati da Reuters. ** Inoltre, [USN:ZON00GKHK TEXT:"i dati sul Pil"] del secondo trimestre hanno evidenziato che l’economia statunitense è cresciuta a un ritmo sostenuto, trainata dalla robusta spesa dei consumatori e dagli investimenti delle imprese legati allo sviluppo delle infrastrutture per l’IA. ** Secondo i dati raccolti da Lseg, gli operatori ritengono ora che la probabilità di un rialzo dei tassi a ottobre sia pari a circa il 35%, in calo rispetto al 45% circa previsto prima della pubblicazione dei dati. ** La maggior parte delle megacap e dei titoli 'growth' è in rialzo nelle prime fasi di negoziazione: AMAZON.COM (AMZN.O) , APPLE (AAPL.O) e ALPHABET (GOOGL.O) guadagnano rispettivamente l'1,7%, il 2,5 e il 3%. ** Alle 16.40 l’indice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) cede lo 0,01% a 51.346,62, l’S&P 500 (.SPX) guadagna lo 0,58% a 7.715,25 e il Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) guadagna lo 0,79% a 27.008,69. ** Cinque settori su 11 dell’S&P 500 scambiano in positivo, con il settore dell’information technology (.SPLRCT) e l'energia (.SPNY) in testa ai rialzi. ** Il settore immobiliare (.SPLRCR) e quello finanziario (.SPSY) registrano le performance peggiori.

item.title: In peggioramento con finanziari, forte Technoprobe, balza Bff
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sull'andamento della Borsa di Milano:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sull'andamento della Borsa di Milano: 16,30 - La borsa milanese peggiora negli scambi pomeridiani, nonostante l'apertura positiva di Wall Street in scia ai dati sull'inflazione migliori del previsto. L'indice Ftse Mib perde lo 0,7%, avviandosi a chiudere il mese di settembre con un calo complessivo di poco sopra il 2%, dopo cinque mesi consecutivi positivi. Dopo il rally di inizio agosto, l'indice ha progressivamente ripiegato sotto il peso dei rialzi del greggio e dei rendimenti obbligazionari e si appresta a chiudere il terzo trimestre con un calo dello 0,5%. A pesare sul Ftse Mib oggi è in particolare il settore finanziario con GENERALI (GASI.MI) che cede oltre il 2%, mentre tra i bancari BANCO BPM (BAMI.MI) perde l'1,5% su un comparto (.FTITLMS3010) in calo in media dell'1%. Si mantiene in deciso rialzo TECHNOPROBE (TPRO.MI) (+2,7%) al termine di una settimana brillante sull'euforia per i tech e IA. Tra i titolo minori, accelera BFF (BFF.MI) (+2,7%) dopo l'annuncio di un accordo vincolante con un fondo per la cessione di un portafoglio di crediti verso la pubblica amministrazione in Italia e Spagna. 12.45 - Piazza Affari passa in territorio negativo a fine mattinata e si avvia ad archiviare in ribasso un settembre turbolento, interrompendo una serie di cinque mesi consecutivi positivi. La consueta volatilità di fine trimestre, con gli operatori che tendono a chiudere le posizioni, si inserisce in un contesto di mercato difficile per le preoccupazioni per gli effetti dei prezzi del petrolio sui rendimenti obbligazionari globali, penalizzando l'appetito per gli asset più rischiosi. Il FTSE Mib (.FTMIB) cede lo 0,1% perdendo l'iniziale sostegno dei bancari, e resta appesantito dai petroliferi, malgrado il ritorno al rialzo dei prezzi del greggio. Tra le note positive prosegue il rally di TECHNOPROBE (TPRO.MI) che, con un rialzo del 4%, si porta sui massimi da circa due mesi e mezzo mentre il settore dei chip attende i conti trimestrali di Micron. Tonici BANCA MEDIOLANUM (BMED.MI) e FINECOBANK (FBK.MI) dopo che JP Morgan ha ripreso la copertura sui due titoli con raccomandazione "overweight". 11.25 - FINECOBANK (FBK.MI) e BANCA MEDIOLANUM (BMED.MI) sono in buon rialzo, sovraperformando l'indice Ftse Mib dopo che JP Morgan ha ripreso la copertura sui due titoli con raccomandazione "overweight", indicando un contesto favorevole in Italia per i gruppi specializzati nella raccolta del risparmio. Fineco sale dell'1,77% a 22,39 euro, e Banca Mediolanum dell'1,5% a 23,91 euro, entrambe tra le migliori del comparto finanziario. JP Morgan ha fissato un target price di 29 euro per Fineco e di 28 euro per Banca Mediolanum. Entrambi i titoli sono stati inoltre inseriti nella lista di "positive catalyst watch" in vista dei conti del terzo trimestre prevedendo possibili revisioni al rialzo delle stime di consenso grazie a un margine d'interesse più robusto del previsto. 10.15 - TECHNOGYM (TGYM.MI) balza del 2,3% a 13,55 euro. Equita nel daily conferma le stime, di poco sopra il consensus, per il terzo trimestre in vista dei risultati del 28 ottobre. Il broker si attende che la società "riaffermi il messaggio di fiducia sul consensus per l'anno in corso" e conferma "le stime di Ebitda a 231 milioni di euro". 9.45 - JUVENTUS (JUVE.MI) perde il 7,5% in borsa dopo essere scesa fino a oltre -15% nei primi scambi sulla scia di conti deludenti e dell'annuncio di un aumento di capitale fino a 250 milioni di euro. L'esercizio al 30 giugno evidenzia [USN:INFbdCv49 TEXT:"una perdita di 66 milioni"] e un debito di 331 milioni, in aumento rispetto all'anno prima e peggiori delle attese, secondo Kepler Cheuvreux. Il club ha quindi convocato per il 3 novembre un'assemblea per approvare una ricapitalizzazione per un necessario rafforzamento patrimoniale (ex art. 2443). Exor (EXOR.AS) , che detiene il 65,4% di Juventus, ha già ha espresso l'impegno ad aderire "sino a sua copertura integrale" ed effettuerà immediatamente un versamento in conto futuro aumento di capitale per 60 milioni. Nella nota il club precisa che le esigenze per l’esercizio corrente e – in misura minore – per quello successivo, ammontano indicativamente al 45%-50% del valore complessivo della delega. Equita nota che è il quarto aumento di capitale di Juventus dal 2019 per un totale di 1,15 miliardi di euro. 9.15 - Avvio in rialzo per Piazza Affari, come per le altre borse europee, in una seduta che attende in mattinata le letture preliminari sull'inflazione delle principali economie della zona euro. Il FTSE Mib (.FTMIB) sale dello 0,7% sostenuto dalle banche (+0,9% in media). In luce MEDIOLANUM (BMED.MI) e FINECOBANK (FBK.MI) dopo che JP Morgan ha riavviato la copertura con 'o[USN:L8N45M041 TEXT:"verweight' su entrambi i titoli"]. Affonda JUVENTUS (JUVE.MI) (-7%, sopra i minimi d'apertura) che ha preannunciato ieri sera un [USN:INFbdCv49 TEXT:"aumento di capitale"] fino a 250 milioni di euro dopo aver chiuso l'esercizio in perdita.

item.title: RAG-Stiftung könnte sich auch von komplettem Evonik-Anteil trennen
item.description: Die Evonik-Großaktionärin, die Essener RAG-Stiftung, könnte ihren Anteil an dem Essener Spezialchemiekonzern komplett verkaufen. "Gemäß Stiftungssatzung ist eine Komplettveräußerung der Evonik möglich", teilte die Essener Stiftung am Mittwoch auf Anfrage mit. Sie hatte in der Vergangenheit erklärt, ihren Anteil auf eine Sperrminorität von 25,1 Prozent abschmelzen zu wollen. Dabei muss es für die Kohle-Stiftung bei dem Essener Konzern, der das Übernahmeinteresse des Konkurrenten BASF geweckt hat, aber nicht bleiben. Mit Zustimmung des Kuratoriums der Stiftung sei auch ein Verkauf weiterer Anteile bis hin zu einer völligen Trennung möglich, hieß es weiter. Hierfür ist keine Satzungsänderung erforderlich.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Evonik (EVKn.DE) -Großaktionärin, die Essener RAG-Stiftung, könnte ihren Anteil an dem Essener Spezialchemiekonzern komplett verkaufen. "Gemäß Stiftungssatzung ist eine Komplettveräußerung der Evonik möglich", teilte die Essener Stiftung am Mittwoch auf Anfrage mit. Sie hatte in der Vergangenheit erklärt, ihren Anteil auf eine Sperrminorität von 25,1 Prozent abschmelzen zu wollen. Dabei muss es für die Kohle-Stiftung bei dem Essener Konzern, der das Übernahmeinteresse des Konkurrenten BASF (BASFn.DE) geweckt hat, aber nicht bleiben. Mit Zustimmung des Kuratoriums der Stiftung sei auch ein Verkauf weiterer Anteile bis hin zu einer völligen Trennung möglich, hieß es weiter. Hierfür ist keine Satzungsänderung erforderlich. Der Stiftung kommt bei einer möglichen Übernahme Evoniks angesichts ihrer Rolle als größte Aktionärin eine Schlüsselrolle zu - sie hält rund 43 Prozent der Anteile. Sie steht mit ihrem milliardenschweren Vermögen für die Folgekosten des deutschen Steinkohlebergbaus gerade. Das Kuratorium wird von Politikern und Gewerkschaftern geprägt. Vorsitzender ist der CDU-Politiker Armin Laschet. Auch NRW-Ministerpräsident Hendrik Wüst, die saarländische Regierungschefin Anke Rehlinger, Bundesfinanzminister Lars Klingbeil, Bundeswirtschaftsministerin Katherina Reiche und IG-BCE-Chef Michael Vassiliadis gehören dem Gremium unter anderem an.

item.title: US ceasefire plan for Sudan could lead to Libya-style partition, adviser says
item.description: A US ceasefire proposal to pause Sudan's civil war could push the country towards a Libya-style partition in its current form, a top adviser to Sudan's army-led authorities told Reuters, in some of the strongest criticism by a Sudanese official of the plan so far.
item.dc:creator: Khalid Abdelaziz
item.content:encoded: A US ceasefire proposal to pause Sudan's [USN:L6N40Y0KB TEXT:"civil war"] could push the country towards a Libya-style partition in its current form, a top adviser to Sudan's army-led authorities told Reuters, in some of the strongest criticism by a Sudanese official of the plan so far. The remarks come a week after [USN:L6N45E0RI TEXT:"Reuters reported"] that army leader General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan's visa to attend the UN General Assembly in New York had been withheld because he had not yet accepted the proposal. Sudan's army has been fighting the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces since April 2023, when the two fell out over issues including how to integrate their forces in a planned transition to civilian rule. The proposal, put forward by US Senior Advisor for Arab and African Affairs Massad Boulos, would impose a 90-day ceasefire, followed by negotiations to end the war and resume the move to civilian rule. Amjad Farid, an adviser to Burhan on political and international affairs, told Reuters that the army-led government had presented its [USN:L6N43C14C TEXT:"proposed changes"] to the deal, chief among them an internationally monitored withdrawal of the RSF from urban areas, but the US had appeared to ignore them. "Mr Boulos seems to be putting pressure on us to accept a de facto partitioning of the country similar to Libyan model," he told Reuters, speaking from New York where he attended the General Assembly. "Our concern is that the approach Mr Boulos continues to advance appears to accommodate the militia’s continued existence and preserve a place for it in Sudan’s political future," he added, referring to the RSF. A Sudanese delegation had been preparing to meet Boulos to discuss the ceasefire in Washington last week, but the meeting was cancelled after Burhan's visa was withheld, two Sudanese diplomats told Reuters, asking not to be named because they were not authorised to speak. The US State Department did not immediately respond to a request for comment. [USN:L6N45F185 TEXT:"Last week"], it said neither the RSF nor the armed forces "represent legitimate, constitutional governance for Sudan." EFFORTS TO SET UP PARALLEL GOVERNMENT The US has accused the RSF of committing genocide and the army of carrying out war crimes, including the use of chemical weapons. Analysts and officials have long raised fears that the conflict could lead to a de facto division of Sudan that resembles neighbouring Libya, which has been split into rival eastern and western administrations for over a decade. Since last year the RSF has been trying to establish its own parallel government in the city of Nyala in the western Darfur region. Ministers have been appointed and some police are active, though they have not set up public services or institutions such as schools, hospitals and courts. Following recent battlefield defeats, the RSF has not made any recent statements on the US proposal and its leader has said its fighters intend to continue the war.

item.title: Judge blocks New York rent-setting software ban
item.description: A federal judge in Manhattan blocked New York state from enforcing a first-of-its-kind law prohibiting landlords and real estate industry professionals from using algorithmic pricing tools to set, and potentially inflate, residential rents.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Stempel
item.content:encoded: A federal judge in Manhattan blocked New York state from enforcing a first-of-its-kind law prohibiting landlords and real estate industry professionals from using algorithmic pricing tools to set, and potentially inflate, residential rents. US District Judge Valerie Caproni issued a preliminary injunction on Tuesday in favor of RealPage, a software provider owned by private equity firm Thoma Bravo, which said the law violated its First Amendment free speech rights by restricting use of its software's pricing recommendations. The antitrust law was signed in October by Governor Kathy Hochul and sponsored by Brad Hoylman-Sigal, then a state senator and now Manhattan borough president. Hoylman-Sigal said the law would help New York crack down on practices that artificially inflated rents and made living in the state unaffordable for many. The state put the law on hold while Caproni considered the case. In her 27-page decision, Caproni said that while it was a "close call," RealPage was "marginally" likely to show that the law was unconstitutional. "Under the rubric of preventing price fixing, the statute prohibits normal commercial conduct just because it is facilitated by software," she wrote. "Whether one is considering a residential landlord or a manufacturer of widgets, there is nothing untoward about considering prices charged by competitors when deciding how to price one's own product." The office of New York Attorney General Letitia James defended the law, saying the state could regulate anticompetitive conduct by technology companies that "wreaked havoc" on the housing rental market. It also said the law regulated conduct rather than protected speech. James' office declined to comment on Wednesday. Hoylman-Sigal's office did not immediately respond to requests for comment. A RealPage spokesperson had no immediate comment. Richardson, Texas-based RealPage sued two days after reaching a settlement with the US Department of Justice and agreeing to restrict its algorithmic software from using non-public data from competitors to generate price recommendations.

item.title: EU aviation agency issues Saudi airspace advisory after Houthi attacks
item.description: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency issued an advisory to airlines to avoid Saudi airspace, according to a bulletin posted on its website on Wednesday, following a recent increase in attacks by the Iran-aligned Houthis.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency issued an advisory to airlines to avoid Saudi airspace, according to a bulletin posted on its website on Wednesday, following a recent increase in attacks by the Iran-aligned Houthis. The latest advisory on Saudi Arabia does not mention Wednesday's [USN:L1N45M07P TEXT:"incident"] involving a diverted flydubai airliner, and the EASA said it will continue to monitor the situation to assess whether there is an increase or decrease in risk for EU airlines in the country. The EASA, in a separate bulletin, recommended flights not operate within the airspace of Jordan at all altitudes and flight levels, a [USN:FWN44S064 TEXT:"change"] from a previous advisory to exercise caution. The agency also extended until November 16 its warning to airlines to avoid the airspace over Lebanon, Iran and Iraq, and also over the territorial Gulf waters of Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates and Oman, revising earlier bulletins that recommended avoiding those countries' entire airspace. The seven-month-old conflict in the Middle East, sparked by US and Israeli attacks on Iran, has seen Tehran strike US allies in the Gulf with drones and missiles while Yemen's Houthis have targeted Saudi interests.

item.title: AMD takes an $8 bln leap at Nvidia
item.description: Boss Lisa Su is using pricey stock to bet on tech that could help bundle software with chips for robotics. If it works, it could narrow a profitability gap with her arch-rival led by Jensen Huang. If not, a $1 trln market value gives the company cover to walk away without scars.
item.dc:creator: Pranav Kiran
item.content:encoded: Lisa Su has a lot of room for error. The chief executive of chipmaker AMD (AMD.O) is using pricey stock to buy startup World Labs for $8.2 billion. It’s one among a slew of deals that could help the company bundle both silicon and software for robotics, like larger rival Nvidia (NVDA.O) does. If the strategy works, it could narrow a profitability gap with the firm led by Jensen Huang. If not, a $1 trillion market value gives the company cover to walk away without significant scars. AMD has long been in the shadow of Nvidia, a $5.5 trillion powerhouse that emerged as the industry standard for training artificial intelligence models in part thanks to its exclusive CUDA software. Clients in AI, robotics and self-driving built their systems around this combination. In recent years, that’s widened Nvidia’s profitability far ahead of AMD’s. Su now has an opening to build that profit engine at AMD. A combination of surging demand for traditional processors and market fears that Nvidia is too entangled with the success of OpenAI and Anthropic has made AMD’s stock attractive currency while depressing shares of Nvidia. There’s sound logic to the deal. World Labs, co-founded by AI pioneer Fei-Fei Li and backed by AMD’s corporate venture capital arm, develops so-called world models that can help train robots to perform tasks by building working representations of three-dimensional reality. JPMorgan reckons robotics could be a $2.5 trillion market by 2035. Chips and software make up roughly 6% of a robot’s bill of materials. Drone output last year rose some 30% to around 16 million units worldwide, but production of humanoids and quadrupeds is rising even faster, doubling every 6 and 10 months, respectively, according to research outfit Epoch AI. The deal is also part of a slew of others, including for Taalas, ZT Systems and Silo AI, that should help AMD better combine chips, systems, software and models. It’s a difficult strategy, given Nvidia’s competing Omniverse platform has a lead in the market. But for AMD, the opportunity cost could be far greater than the failure of a relatively small acquisition. Follow Pranav Kiran on Bluesky and X . Advanced Micro Devices said on September 28 that it would acquire Fei-Fei Li's AI startup, World Labs, in an all-stock deal valued at $8.2 billion. World Labs raised $1 billion in a funding round earlier this year that included an investment from AMD. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Russia draws up measures to control bear population after spate of deadly attacks
item.description: The Russian government said on Wednesday it was drawing up urgent measures to control the population of brown bears that has spiralled out of control in some regions, with at least 22 people killed in attacks.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Osborn
item.content:encoded: The Russian government said on Wednesday it was drawing up urgent measures to control the population of brown bears that has spiralled out of control in some regions, with at least 22 people killed in attacks. In the latest attack, reported by state media, a 23-year-old man out gathering berries was killed by a bear this week in Kamchatka, in Russia's far east. Last week, a Russian woman in Siberia was [USN:L1N45H0JI TEXT:"fatally mauled by a bear in her garden"], amid a nationwide spate of killings that experts blame on climate change and human incompetence. "It is clear that as the population grows, so too does the number of problems. Systemic measures are needed to ensure that humans and animals can coexist safely and to maintain the necessary balance," said Deputy Prime Minister Dmitry Patrushev. "In this regard, the Russian government is currently preparing a series of priority measures," he said. The government said it would look at lifting hunting quotas on brown bears, would establish regional population limits, give local authorities extra powers to control their numbers, and identify regions that need more financing to tackle the problem. The population of brown bears has more than doubled in the last three decades to 308,000, in part due to shorter and milder winters. At least 22 people have been killed by bears across Russia, the world's largest country, since this spring, the RIA state news agency said. Experts cited in Russian media have said bears have been forced to look further afield for food this year because an early and dry spring meant there was a lack of berries for them to feed on in September. People are also guilty of leaving food waste out in the open where it attracts bears and of ignoring safety rules, experts say. Investigators in Krasnoyarsk in Siberia — home to nearly 27,000 bears according to environment ministry data — said last week that they had opened a criminal case into the local environment ministry, accusing it of negligence that led to the deaths of seven people in September alone. The federal environment ministry has sought to play down the spate of attacks, saying that around 20 to 30 cases of bear attacks have been recorded annually in recent years, but that social media and smartphones are making such attacks seem more widespread.
