The Alaska LNG project would include a pipeline carrying natural gas from the North Slope to a liquefaction facility on the state's southern coast, allowing the fuel to be shipped to Asian markets. Trump has repeatedly promoted the project as a way to expand U.S. energy exports and strengthen ties with allies including South Korea and Japan. The project has faced years of uncertainty over its cost, financing and commercial viability. Investment from Seoul could provide a potential source of financing. South Korean opposition lawmakers have raised concerns about the commercial viability and fiscal risks of investments in U.S. projects. "Before considering political needs or diplomatic demands, however, it was necessary to thoroughly verify the commercial rationale and viability of any investment that put a tremendous burden on the public," Kim Sung-won, a South Korean lawmaker who chairs parliament's trade committee, told Reuters on Wednesday. Kim said South Korea's National Assembly would closely examine the profitability of U.S. investment projects and the benefits for Korean companies. Japan's two biggest LNG importers, JERA and Tokyo Gas, have signed preliminary agreements to buy a combined 2 million metric tons a year from Alaska LNG if it is built. Glenfarne, the project's developer, said in March it had lined up commitments for 13 million tons a year, but needed another 3 million tons to secure financing and make all commitments binding. U.S. and South Korean officials have been working to identify projects for Seoul's investment package, with Alaska LNG, nuclear power and a gas-fired power project in Texas among those discussed.

(Reporting By Jarrett Renshaw, Editing by Nick Zieminski)

Source: Reuters

item.title: Trump to unveil $200 billion investment in US projects by South Korea, White House says
item.description: President Donald Trump will announce on Wednesday plans for South Korea to invest $200 billion in US projects, including $54 billion to build the long-planned Alaska liquefied natural gas project, a White House official said.
item.dc:creator: Jarrett Renshaw, Trevor Hunnicutt
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump will announce on Wednesday plans for South Korea to invest $200 billion in US projects, including $54 billion to build the long-planned Alaska liquefied natural gas project, a White House official said. The announcement will detail the first major projects under a broader [USN:L4N45D0DQ TEXT:"$350 billion strategic investment package"] South Korea made as part of a trade agreement with Washington last year. The $350 billion package includes $150 billion for shipbuilding and $200 billion for strategic investments. The White House official said the investments would include the Alaska LNG pipeline project, eight large-scale nuclear power plants and a 6-gigawatt power generation facility in Texas. The announcement would be part of a series of economic and investment deals Trump is highlighting ahead of November's midterm elections , as he seeks to reinforce his economic record amid voter concerns over the Iran war and high gasoline prices. The Alaska LNG project also comes as Republicans seek to retain incumbent Senator Dan Sullivan who faces Democrat Mary Peltola. "Today, President Trump will announce major energy infrastructure investments that deliver on his day one promises to unleash American energy, unlock Alaska's extraordinary resource potential, and accelerate America's nuclear energy renaissance," White House spokeswoman Taylor Rogers said. [USN:L4N45M0CI TEXT:"The Alaska LNG project"] would include an 807-mile pipeline carrying natural gas from the North Slope to a liquefaction facility on Alaska's southern coast, allowing the fuel to be shipped to Asian markets. The project is designed to transport about 3.9 billion cubic feet of natural gas per day and produce up to 20 million metric tons of LNG annually, according to the White House. Trump has repeatedly promoted the project as a way to expand U.S. energy exports and strengthen ties with allies including South Korea and Japan. The project has faced years of uncertainty over its cost, financing and commercial viability. South Korea's investment could provide a potential source of financing, although Seoul has previously said projects under its US investment package must meet commercial viability standards. South Korean opposition lawmakers have raised concerns about the commercial viability and fiscal risks of investments in US projects. "Before considering political needs or diplomatic demands, however, it was necessary to thoroughly verify the commercial rationale and viability of any investment that put a tremendous burden on the public," Kim Sung-won, a South Korean lawmaker who chairs parliament's trade committee, told Reuters on Wednesday. South Korea's industry ministry said last week that a more than 6-gigawatt gas-fired power plant in Encinal, Texas, was the first project selected under the $200 billion strategic investment program. The ministry was also considering the construction of eight large nuclear reactors and the Alaska LNG project. COMMITMENTS NEED TO BE BINDING Japan's two biggest LNG importers, JERA and Tokyo Gas, have signed preliminary agreements to buy a combined 2 million metric tons a year from Alaska LNG if it is built. Glenfarne, the project's developer, said in March it had lined up commitments for 13 million tons a year, but needed another 3 million tons to secure financing and make all commitments binding. It did not immediately respond to a request for comment about Wednesday's plan. The eight nuclear plants would form part of Trump's effort to expand U.S. nuclear generation as electricity demand rises, including from data centers and manufacturing. South Korea has been discussing a potential investment in U.S. nuclear projects as part of the broader package. The Texas gas-fired power project is expected to supply electricity to energy-intensive facilities, including semiconductor plants and data centers. South Korean officials have said the project was selected after reviews of its commercial viability.

item.description:
Lucia Mutikani
[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 米商務省経済分析局（ＢＥＡ）が３０日発表した８月の...

item.content:encoded:
米8月ＰＣＥ価格指数、前年比＋3.4％で横ばい　利上げ観測後退 9/30 22:06 配信

ニューヨーク市内の食料品店で8月26日撮影 REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン ３０日 ロイター] - 米商務省経済分析局（ＢＥＡ）が３０日発表した８月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．４％上昇し、７月の３．４％上昇から横ばいとなった。伸びは市場予想を下回り、７月分も当初の３．７％上昇から下方改定されたことから、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による１０月の追加利上げ観測は後退した。

前月比では０．３％上昇、ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想の０．４％上昇を下回った。７月は０．２％上昇から０．１％上昇に下方改定された。

ＢＥＡはＰＣＥ価格指数でソフトウエアと付属品、資産運用手数料、法務サービスの価格算出方法を変更。また２０２１年まで遡及改定した。

変動の大きい食品・エネルギーを除くコアＰＣＥ価格指数は前年比３．０％上昇と前月から横ばい。７月は３．３％上昇から３．０％上昇に下方改定された。

前月比は０．２％上昇。７月は０．２％上昇から０．１％上昇に下方改定された。

ＢＭＯキャピタル・マーケッツのシニアエコノミスト、サル・グアティエリ氏は「８月のＰＣＥが懸念されたほど強くなかったことで、ＦＲＢはデータをさらに見極める時間を確保でき、１０月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げは見送りとなる可能性がある。ただ、インフレ高止まりと消費および経済の底堅さは、年内に追加利上げがあることを示唆している」と述べた。

個人消費支出は前月比０．９％増。７月は０．２％増から０．１％増に下方改定された。

個人所得は０．２％増加。インフレ調整後の可処分所得は横ばいだった。

貯蓄率は４．１％と、７月の４．６％から低下した。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込む１０月２７─２８日のＦＯＭＣでの利上げ確率は約３４．９％。ＰＣＥ発表前の５１．５％、２８日の７０％から低下した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：米利上げでアジア株式市場に明暗、経常赤字国の打撃大きく 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か 最終更新: 10/1(木) 1:12 ロイター

item.title: La France et le Royaume-Uni discutent de la fin de leur accord migratoire
item.description: La France et le Royaume-Uni sont en discussion pour mettre fin à leur accord prévoyant de renvoyer vers l'Hexagone des migrants arrivant sur le territoire britannique à bord de petites embarcations, a-t-on appris mercredi d'une source au sein du ministère français de l'Intérieur.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La France et le Royaume-Uni sont en discussion pour mettre fin à leur accord prévoyant de renvoyer vers l'Hexagone des migrants arrivant sur le territoire britannique à bord de petites embarcations, a-t-on appris mercredi d'une source au sein du ministère français de l'Intérieur. "Nous discutons avec les Britanniques sur les modalités de sortie de l'accord", souligne-t-on Place Beauvau. Un porte-parole du département britannique de l'Intérieur a confirmé que le programme pilote entre Paris et Londres "n'acceptait plus de nouveaux dossiers", ajoutant que la coopération entre les deux capitales perdurait. "Les vols se poursuivront au cours des prochaines semaines afin d’expulser rapidement du Royaume-Uni les migrants arrivés par embarcation de petite taille", a-t-il précisé. "Nous mettrons à profit les enseignements tirés de ce projet pilote pour accélérer les efforts visant à renvoyer les migrants arrivés par embarcation de petite taille qui n’ont pas le droit de rester au Royaume-Uni." L'accord annoncé l'an dernier par Paris et Londres visait à réduire le flux de migrants arrivant clandestinement sur le territoire britannique via la Manche, sur le principe du "un pour un". Pour chaque renvoi en France d'un migrant sans papiers, un demandeur d'asile se trouvant dans l'Hexagone et ayant des liens familiaux avec le Royaume-Unis était pris en charge par Londres, selon les termes de l'accord. Le ministère français de l'Intérieur n'a pas fourni dans l'immédiat de précisions sur les raisons de ces discussions. Au coeur des principales préoccupations des 'Brexiters', la question de l'immigration est restée depuis lors un enjeu majeur pour Downing Street, le nombre de traversées illégales de la Manche ayant atteint des records, crispant les relations entre Paris et Londres.

Synopsys, Amazon Web Services sign chip design licensing deal worth more than $1 billion

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO, Sept 30 : Synopsys and Amazon Web Services on Wednesday said that Amazon.com's cloud computing unit has entered a multi-year deal worth more than $1 billion to license chip design intellectual property from Synopsys. Synopsys makes software for designing complex computer chips, helping firms such as Nvidia and Intel decide how to lay out tens of billions of transistors on a few square millimeters of silicon. But it also increasingly licenses blueprints for parts of a chip, a business that brought in $1.75 billion in revenue in its most recent fiscal year and where it competes against Arm Holdings. In its early stages, the Synopsys design licensing business focused on common parts of chips where customers found it more cost-effective to license blueprints from Synopsys than to design those parts from scratch. But Synopsys has moved into more complex designs such as computing cores and said the deal on Wednesday will focus on blueprints optimized for specific types of chips. AWS designs a variety of its own chips, including its Graviton central processors and its Trainium AI chips. The two parties did not specify which AWS chips will use Synopsys blueprints.  As part of the deal, Synopsys will also adopt AWS computing and storage services, as well as Amazon Bedrock to build and deploy AI applications.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Operadores reducen apuestas de alza de tasas de la Fed en octubre
item.description: Un alza de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal el próximo mes parecía menos probable el miércoles, después de que nuevos datos gubernamentales mostraran que la inflación aumentó menos de lo previsto en agosto, lo que alivió la presión sobre el banco central estadounidense para actuar previo a unas elecciones nacionales muy reñidas en noviembre.
item.dc:creator: Ann Saphir
item.content:encoded: Un alza de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal el próximo mes parecía menos probable el miércoles, después de que nuevos datos gubernamentales mostraran que la inflación aumentó menos de lo previsto en agosto, lo que alivió la presión sobre el banco central estadounidense para actuar previo a unas elecciones nacionales muy reñidas en noviembre. El índice de precios de los gastos de consumo personal (PCE, por su sigla en inglés) aumentó un 3,4% en los 12 meses hasta agosto, informó la Oficina de Análisis Económico, tras registrarse un 3,4% en julio, una cifra revisada a la baja. Los economistas esperaban que el aumento de agosto fuera del 3,7%. Los analistas señalaron que, dado que la inflación sigue situándose por encima del objetivo del 2% de la Fed, es probable que se produzca otra subida de tipos más adelante en el año. "El porcentaje de componentes de precios del PCE que aumentan a un ritmo superior al 3% anual se redujo ligeramente, pasando del 54% al 51%; no obstante, esta cifra sigue siendo muy superior a lo habitual, por lo que hay pocos motivos para pensar que la tendencia subyacente de la inflación haya mejorado de forma significativa", escribió Sal Guatieri, economista senior de BMO. "Esto reforzará la opinión de la Reserva Federal de que es necesario un mayor endurecimiento de la política monetaria para devolver la inflación a su objetivo". La Fed recibirá más datos en las semanas previas a su reunión del 27 y 28 de octubre, incluido el informe mensual de empleo que se publicará el viernes y el reporte sobre la inflación al consumidor de septiembre. Los republicanos defienden sus ajustadas mayorías en el Congreso de cara a las elecciones del 3 de noviembre, y los sondeos indican que el aumento de los precios, impulsado en parte por el encarecimiento de la gasolina debido al conflicto en Oriente Próximo, está erosionando el apoyo de los votantes. El martes, los operadores habían reducido sus apuestas sobre un alza de tasas en octubre, después de que el presidente de la Fed de Nueva York, John Williams, dijera que no veía "ninguna urgencia" en complementar el incremento de septiembre con otro adicional. No obstante, seguía considerando probable que fuera necesaria otra subida para fines de año. El miércoles, los contratos de futuros descontaban una probabilidad de apenas una entre tres de que se produjera una subida de tipos en octubre, aunque los operadores seguían anticipando un incremento para el mes de diciembre.

item.title: Global stocks weather third-quarter AI, bond and crude maelstrom
item.description: LONDON, Sept 30 : Stock market investors might have been expected to run for the hills in the face of an extraordinary surge in global borrowing costs, currency interventions, wars, oil back above $100 a barrel and warnings that AI might wipe out humanity. Yet the most widely tracked world equity indexes are

Global stocks weather third-quarter AI, bond and crude maelstrom

FILE PHOTO: FILE PHOTO: A screen displays stock market information after the opening bell at the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in New York City, U.S., September 15, 2026. REUTERS/Jeenah Moon/File Photo/File Photo

FAST

LONDON, Sept 30 : Stock market investors might have been expected to run for the hills in the face of an extraordinary surge in global borrowing costs, currency interventions, wars, oil back above $100 a barrel and warnings that AI might wipe out humanity. Yet the most widely tracked world equity indexes are just 2 per cent off their all-time highs and up more than 12 per cent for the year after another $3 trillion tick higher during a tumultuous third quarter. Instead it has been G10 government bonds, ultra-safe assets supposed to provide the ballast in global investment portfolios, which have been causing all the worries, especially this month. In the $29-trillion US Treasury market, which anchors pricing for virtually all financial assets, the key 10-year yield has soared past 5 per cent to its highest level since just before the 2007 financial crash.

Yields in Japan have climbed to multi-decade highs too, while those in Germany, France and Britain have all hit 17 to 19 year peaks. As bond prices move inversely to yield it has meant the biggest hit to investors returns in years. AXA's chief economist Gilles Moec said that unlike when Treasury yields spiked above 5 per cent in the 1990s and before the financial crisis, this rise was part of a new clearly upward trend. "What people are worried about is that we are in a completely different structural trend now, that is the long and the short of it," said Moec. "It is making people very, very nervous," he added. FINGERS CROSSED There have been some snags for stock market bulls. South Korea's KOPSI index, whose chipmakers have been a big driver of AI euphoria, has pulled back almost 20 per cent. It makes it its worst quarter since the COVID-19 pandemic, although it is still twice a valuable as it was this time last year. Pictet Asset Management's Arun Sai said world stocks were riding a "truly unprecedented" earnings rise. S&P 500 earnings for example are expected to jump at least 30 per cent this year. "It dwarfs the commodity super cycle, it dwarfs the dotcom boom, everything," said Sai, adding: "We have never seen anything like this outside of a recession recovery". The moment of the quarter for currency markets, meanwhile, was late July's rare coordinated intervention by Japan and the US to prevent the yen's slide to near 40-year lows from destabilising financial markets. While the dollar has fallen 3 per cent versus the Japanese currency this quarter, the recent surge in Treasury yields has driven it back up against other top currencies, particularly the Swiss franc, euro and the Mexican peso. Bitcoin has soared too, while oil's 40 per cent quarterly rise leaves it up 70 per cent for the year. It is also Brent's second-biggest quarterly jump since Q2 2020 after the tumble it took when COVID-19 first shuttered the global economy. Although Turkish markets were rattled this month by what one top official described as a Ponzi-like funds scheme, large, developing economies, like tech stocks, seem to be largely surviving the bond market selloff. "We haven't had the big risk off that we are all afraid of," said Viktor Szabo, an EM portfolio manager at Aberdeen. "So we are still sitting here fingers crossed, but it will be interesting to see what happens with the dollar from here." FINAL LAP There is plenty in store for the rest of the year, with the conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine both grinding on. Interest rates are expected to keep rising and the first weekend throws up the first round of the presidential election in Brazil, South America's biggest economy. US midterm elections in early November will be even bigger, with polls showing US President Donald Trump's Republican party could lose the House of Representatives and maybe even the Senate. That could make for a very interesting end to 2026, although what investors want to know most is how high bond yields might go and whether the AI-driven equity rally cracks. "Whether or not this breaks markets?" Kathryn Exum Co-Head of Sovereign Research & Strategy at Gramercy said, referring to level of borrowing costs. "I think you'd have to see these (10-year Treasury) yield levels sustained at a little bit higher rate than where we're at currently."

Source: Reuters

item.title: Mattel taps Condé Nast's Lynch as CEO Kreiz, who led brand revival, departs
item.description: Mattel's longtime CEO Ynon Kreiz, who led the toymaker's transformation into a broader entertainment company, is stepping down and will be succeeded by board member Roger Lynch, head of Vogue and New Yorker owner Condé Nast.
item.dc:creator: Neil Kanatt
item.content:encoded: Mattel's longtime CEO Ynon Kreiz, who led the toymaker's transformation into a broader entertainment company, is stepping down and will be succeeded by board member Roger Lynch, head of Vogue and New Yorker owner Condé Nast. The change comes ahead of the crucial holiday season, with Mattel facing tariff-related costs and activist investor pressure over its declining shareholder value despite efforts to build on the success of 2023's blockbuster "Barbie" movie. Kreiz, who has led Mattel since 2018, is heading to Paramount Skydance (PSKY.O) in a senior role following its [USN:L6N45D0SG TEXT:"$110 billion"] Warner Bros deal, Bloomberg News reported, citing a person familiar with the matter. Mattel and Paramount declined to comment, while Kreiz did not respond to a request for comment. Kreiz's push to turn Mattel's intellectual property into films, television shows and digital games delivered the global box-office hit "Barbie" and boosted demand for its merchandise. Yet Mattel shares have risen just 5% during Kreiz's tenure as CEO, sharply underperforming a nearly 200% gain in the S&P 500 (.SPX) over the same period. Shares of the Barbie doll and Hot Wheels maker fell 4% in afternoon trading. "This announcement adds a layer of uncertainty to an already skittish investor sentiment given a tougher macro backdrop, rising rates, and likely a more Q4-weighted outcome," UBS analysts wrote in a note. Earlier this year, investor Southeastern Asset Management urged [USN:L4N41L1BU TEXT:"Mattel to explore options"], including a sale of the company or a combination with rival Hasbro (HAS.O) . Lynch has served on Mattel's board since 2018 and is expected to assume the top role by November 2. Meanwhile, Condé Nast, where Lynch has been CEO for about seven years, named board member Mike Perlis as interim CEO. Lynch, who will be taking the helm of a sixth company, is best known for leading Condé Nast, Pandora and Sling TV, bringing media, satellite and digital expertise but little direct experience in the toy industry. "Roger's appointment comes at a time when the lines between consumer products and media are more blurred than ever, so it makes sense to place an experienced media operator at the helm," said James Zahn, editor-in-chief at The Toy Book. Last month, Mattel [USN:L6N4411GM TEXT:"topped"] second-quarter revenue estimates and reaffirmed its annual targets, but tariff-related costs and investments to boost sales resulted in profit missing market expectations.

item.title: General Mills names insider McNabb as CEO, succeeding veteran Harmening
item.description: General Mills on Wednesday appointed Chief Operating Officer Dana McNabb as its CEO, leaning on an insider to steer the company through a difficult environment of high inflation, low consumer spending and private labels eroding branded goods' market share.
item.dc:creator: Anuja Mistry, Alexander Marrow
item.content:encoded: General Mills (GIS.N) on Wednesday appointed Chief Operating Officer Dana McNabb as its CEO, leaning on an insider to steer the company through a difficult environment of high inflation, low consumer spending and private labels eroding branded goods' market share. Consumer goods firms have been [USN:L1N3XM099 TEXT:"changing CEOs"] as boards run out of patience with sluggish growth and companies battle US tariff uncertainty and elevated supply-chain costs from the Middle East conflict while struggling to connect with younger shoppers. McNabb will succeed Jeff Harmening on January 1, when he becomes the executive chair, after nearly a decade as CEO during which he spearheaded the Cheerios maker's entry into the faster-growing pet-food market through its Blue Buffalo deal, reshaped its portfolio and stepped up investment in digital capabilities. McNabb "has a tall task ahead of her," said Stephanie Link, chief investment strategist at General Mills investor Hightower Advisors. "The goal for her is to return the company to profitable growth, build on other divestitures beyond North American yogurt to narrow the product set and focus on core brands – particularly health-focused offerings – and modernize the supply chain," she said. General Mills is facing higher costs, including tariff-related increases in packaging materials, while seeking price hikes to protect its under-pressure margins. McNabb, 50, has spent 27 years at General Mills and held several senior leadership roles across general management, enterprise strategy, marketing and international operations. She will become General Mills' first woman CEO and one of the relatively few women leading a major US consumer-products company. "Dana McNabb's appointment looks like a credible choice to accelerate General Mills' recovery, but investors will need evidence that the company can regain shoppers while rebuilding profitability," said Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management. "Her biggest challenge is making familiar brands worth paying for in a market where consumers remain highly selective," he added. Earlier this month, General Mills [USN:L6N45F0KG TEXT:"beat"] first-quarter sales and profit estimates and reaffirmed its annual forecast. Shares of the company, which are down about 27% so far this year, dipped about 3% in morning trading.

item.title: Conagra sales volumes dip as new CEO Brase grapples with inflation pressures
item.description: Conagra Brands posted a volume-led decline in first-quarter organic net sales on Wednesday, with high inflation and price-sensitive consumers hampering new CEO John Brase's efforts to turn around the packaged foods company.
item.dc:creator: Koyena Das, Alexander Marrow
item.content:encoded: Conagra Brands (CAG.N) posted a volume-led decline in first-quarter organic net sales on Wednesday, with high inflation and price-sensitive consumers hampering new CEO John Brase's efforts to turn around the packaged foods company. The Slim Jim meat sticks maker, whose shares slumped more than 5.5% to an over three-month low, reaffirmed its fiscal 2027 guidance for an organic net sales decline of 1% to 3% from a year earlier, although first-quarter profit and sales beat Wall Street estimates, according to LSEG data. "You definitely have a pressured consumer," Brase told Reuters. "There's no doubt about it." Conagra had halved its annual dividend in July and said it was reviewing its [USN:L6N43H0OQ TEXT:"non-core assets"], with Brase, who took over in June, stating that brands that were not playing a great strategic role could be divested and others added. Persistent inflation — especially in gas prices — and higher borrowing costs have pressured household budgets, prompting consumers to trade down to cheaper private-label alternatives, while the rapid adoption of GLP-1 weight-loss drugs is forcing packaged food makers to reformulate products to meet demand for healthier food. The company expects full-year volume declines in the mid-single digits "factoring in greater-than-historical volume elasticities, particularly within our frozen business," CFO Dave Marberger said in pre-recorded remarks. Pricing and product mix contributed 1% to total organic net sales in the first quarter, with volumes down 2.1%, Conagra said. The drop in sales volumes, inflation pressures and unfavorable operating leverage led to a 3.9% drop in adjusted gross profit to $619 million during the quarter, a fall that was slightly offset by $4 million in tariff refunds. Marberger said that inflation has accelerated around transportation, because "our freight costs have been going up significantly." Prices for animal proteins — particularly chicken, beef and pork — have been more favorable, he added. Quarterly net sales in the refrigerated and frozen segment fell 2.1% from a year earlier, while volumes decreased 1% and prices fell 1.5%. "The core challenge remains unchanged: six consecutive years of volume declines, a portfolio that management acknowledges is too large and too complex, and a consumer environment that is unforgiving of pricing missteps," said RBC analysts in a note. The company's total quarterly net sales came in at $2.60 billion, narrowly beating estimates of $2.59 billion. Quarterly adjusted earnings per share stood at 41 cents, compared with analysts' estimates of 28 cents.

item.title: 英空軍基地事件、逮捕された男の1人が警察に事前通報＝タイムズ
item.description: [ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] - 英紙タイムズは３０日、米軍がイラン攻撃に使用する英西部フェアフォード空軍基地付近で男５人がテロ関連容疑で逮捕された事件について、男の１人が警察に通報したことで陰謀が阻止されたと報じた。

事件を巡る謎はさらに深まった。トランプ米大統領は男らが「甚大な被害」を計画していたと述べ、ルビオ米国務長官が「外国勢力」の関与を指摘したにもかかわらず、５人全員が釈放された。

タイムズによると、男の１人は逮捕される直前に緊急通報を行った。

同紙は「それが監視だったのか、警備体制を試すための『リハーサル』だったのか、あるいは英国政府にメッセージを送るためのパフォーマンスだったのか、全てが検討されている」と報道。捜査当局は彼がおじけづいたのか、それとも計画の一部だったのか判断がついていないと付け加えた。

同紙は情報源に触れていない。

警察当局はコメント要請に応じていない。

item.title: 英中銀、金融リスク顕在化を警告 イラン紛争とＡＩ債務増で
item.description: ［ロンドン ３０日 ロイター］ - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）は３０日、イラン紛争の再激化や人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の債...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英中銀、金融リスク顕在化を警告　イラン紛争とＡＩ債務増で 9/30 19:52 配信

ロンドンのイングランド銀行本部、9月16日撮影 REUTERS/Corey Rudy

［ロンドン　３０日　ロイター］ - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）は３０日、イラン紛争の再激化や人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の債券発行増加を挙げ、金融システム内で相互につながる脆弱性が顕在化するリスクが高まっていると警告した。

英中銀の金融安定政策委員会（ＦＰＣ）は、原油・天然ガス価格の上昇を受け、債券利回りが２００８年以来の水準に上昇したと指摘した。

金融システムと株式市場はこれまでのところ強靭（きょうじん）性を示しているものの、急激な調整の危険性がくすぶっていると警告。金融リスクに応じて水準を調整する「カウンターシクリカル資本バッファー」を２％に据え置いた。

ＦＰＣは四半期会合の議事要旨で、「金融システムの相互に関連する脆弱性が顕在化する可能性は高まっている」と指摘。「具体的には、紛争の再激化とそれに伴う原油、天然ガス、石油製品の価格上昇が、負の供給ショックを一段と長引かせている」とした。

＜ベイリー総裁、ＡＩリスクに懸念＞

ＦＰＣの議長を務めるベイリー英中銀総裁は、ＦＰＣ議事要旨と同時に公表したＡＩリスクに関する寄稿で、最先端ＡＩのリスクへの懸念を詳述し、規制強化の前に「導入の前後に実施する厳格なモデル検証」が必要だと指摘した。

「いずれ、より正式な規制の枠組みが整備される可能性は十分にある。しかし、規制策定から始めるのは適切ではない。まず理解と検証を進め、確実に介入できるポイントを定める必要がある」と記した。

ＦＰＣは、ＡＩ関連の債券発行の「急増」により、資本市場がＡＩの動向に左右される度合いも高まったと指摘した。モルガン・スタンレーが９月上旬に示した推計によると、世界のＡＩ関連債券発行額は約４５００億ドルと、２０２５年の２倍に達した。

ＡＩ関連株と半導体株は７月に急落したものの、市場機能は秩序を保った。ただ、バリュエーションが依然として高い中、より大きなショックが発生すれば、一段と急激な価格調整につながりかねないと英中銀は警告した。

ＡＩシステムが安全措置を回避する可能性を巡り、一連の事案が政策当局者の懸念を強めている。７月にはオープンＡＩのＡＩエージェントが管理された試験環境を抜け出し、ＡＩ企業ハギング・フェイスに不正侵入した。

英中銀は「こうした動きにより、ＡＩの進歩がサイバーリスクや業務運営上のリスクを高める可能性があるとの委員会の評価が一段と裏付けられた」とした。

＜銀行レバレッジ規制と英国債レポ市場改革＞

英中銀は、銀行のレバレッジ規制と英国債レポ市場のルールの変更について、２７年初めにより詳細な案を示すと表明した。英国債レポ市場では、トレーダーが金利変動による利益を狙うほか、投資家が保有債券を利用して一時的に現金を調達している。

ＦＰＣは７月、銀行に総資産に対して一定比率以上の自己資本を保有するよう求めるレバレッジ比率規制について、その影響を緩和する方針を示した。

変更案に関する市中協議は２７年初めに開始する。英中銀は、これにより「英国債レポ市場の強靭性を高める措置の策定と実施を引き続き進める重要性が増す」とした。

ブリーデン副総裁は７月、英国債レポ市場の規制について「何もしないという選択肢はない」と述べた。金融危機時に同市場が原因で債券取引が滞るリスクが残っているためだ。

英中銀のデータによると、英国債レポ市場の純借入額は計約２０００億ポンド（２７００億ドル）。英中銀は、ヘッジファンドのレバレッジがここ数カ月、高水準ながら安定して推移したと説明した。

英中銀は、２０年のコロナ禍と、２２年にトラス首相（当時）の大型減税策が招いた市場混乱（トラスショック）で市場介入を余儀なくされた経緯を踏まえ、２５年に規制強化の初期案を示した。

ただ、金融業界はこれらの案に反発している。ブリーデン氏は、中央清算の利用拡大など一部の改革には「数カ月ではなく、数年かかる可能性が高い」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：ＡＩで相互依存強める新興企業と巨大ＩＴ 最終更新: 9/30(水) 19:52 ロイター

item.description: Sept 30 : Apple is planning to make its long-delayed push into the smart-home market on October 13 with a new hub code-named J490, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.The company also plans to announce the first update to the HomePod mini since the device's 2020 debut

Sept 30 : Apple is planning to make its long-delayed push into the smart-home market on October 13 with a new hub code-named J490, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter. The company also plans to announce the first update to the HomePod mini since the device's 2020 debut and its first new TV set-top box since 2022, the report said. Apple did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Longtime hardware chief John Ternus took over as Apple's CEO earlier this month, with analysts expecting his tenure to bring renewed emphasis on its core strength in devices, engineering and focus on fusing AI capabilities into existing products.

Apple has been seeking to expand its presence in the smart-home market while remaining anchored by its core iPhone business, which serves as the company's flagship product and a key driver of its broader ecosystem. The company currently offers the HomePod and HomePod mini as part of its smart-home product lineup, while the Apple TV 4K set-top box is part of its home entertainment lineup. The upcoming home hub, which is similar to Amazon's Echo and Google Home devices, will take the form of a roughly 6-inch square display, with versions that can be mounted on a wall or placed on a countertop, per the Bloomberg News report on Wednesday. The hub will recognize individual household members and provide personalized content and responses based on their data and accounts, the report said. The new HomePod mini and Apple TV will retain their current designs but include faster processors to support Siri's more powerful AI models, the report said. In June, Apple unveiled a long-delayed overhaul of Siri as part of a broader effort to strengthen its AI capabilities.

item.title: FTSE 100 registers monthly decline as oil rally heightens inflation concerns
item.description: London's FTSE 100 fell on Wednesday and posted a monthly loss as persistent inflation concerns and rising bond yields dampened investor sentiment.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: London's FTSE 100 fell on Wednesday and posted a monthly loss as persistent inflation concerns and rising bond yields dampened investor sentiment. The blue-chip FTSE 100 index (.FTSE) closed 0.29% lower at 10,606 points, registering its biggest monthly loss since March, though notching a seventh consecutive quarterly gain. The midcap FTSE 250 (.FTMC) climbed 0.68% but dipped for the month. Oil prices rose with Brent crude above $103 a barrel, reinforcing inflation concerns and boosting expectations that interest rates could remain higher for a longer period Heavyweight banks (.FTNMX301010) and pharma stocks (.FTNMX502010) were the biggest drags in the blue-chip index, declining 0.7% and 1% respectively Telecom stocks (.FTNMX151020) also dropped, with Airtel Africa (AAF.L) shedding 3.3% Global bonds inched higher, with the yield on the British benchmark 10-year gilt hovering near two-decade highs Reflecting rate tightening across central banks globally, traders are pricing in at least one 25-basis-point rate hike by the Bank of England this year, according to data compiled by LSEG BoE policymaker Alan Taylor said it was [USN:S8N42Q0DN TEXT:"unclear"] that it would be practical for the BoE to do a single rate hike to tame inflation without fuelling unwarranted market speculation of further increases Limiting losses, the utilities sector (.FTUB6510) rose 1.7% a day after British PM Andy Burnham made a series of policy announcements for the sector On the data front, Britain's economy [USN:L8N45M06P TEXT:"grew more quickly"] than previously thought in the second quarter, with output expanding by 0.5% in the April-to-June period, the Office for National Statistics said Among other stocks, Greggs (GRG.L) advanced 8.2% after the fast-food chain [USN:L8N45M070 TEXT:"raised"] its annual profit outlook as underlying sales growth accelerated in the third quarter Holiday and insurance group Saga (SAGA.L) surged 22.8% to a near seven-year high after [USN:L6N45M0CI TEXT:"forecasting"] materially higher annual profit

FAST

WASHINGTON, Sept 30 : In-space manufacturing startup Varda Space has raised $250 million in a Series D round at a $1.6 billion valuation, the company told Reuters, as it ramps up missions to produce pharmaceuticals in microgravity. El Segundo-based Varda is one of a handful of US companies building a fleet of uncrewed space capsules that can function as orbital laboratories or manufacturing platforms for products whose development in space yields better efficiencies or purities than in the gravity of Earth. The $250 million round closed this month, led by Lux Capital and Natural Capital, putting Varda's total amount raised at $598 million since its founding in 2021 by CEO and former SpaceX engineer Will Bruey and Founders Fund partner Delian Asparouhov. The company since 2023 has deployed six missions to orbit with its gumdrop-shaped free-flying W-Series capsule, with all but its fourth mission successfully re-entering from space. It plans to debut a next-generation capsule in 2030.

Varda is planning to launch two capsules to space at once for the first time on Thursday, using a rideshare mission on SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket. The two capsules are carrying hypersonic research payloads for the Pentagon and commercial customers. SpaceX is phasing out its Falcon rocket and winding down rideshare missions, alarming much of the spacecraft industry, Reuters has reported. But Varda is largely insulated from the launch squeeze – it has 28 launches with different providers booked through 2027 to 2029, Bruey said. While orbital re-entries have drawn keen interest from the Pentagon's Golden Dome missile defense efforts, Varda has bet on the pharmaceutical industry for much of its commercial operations.  "The biggest milestone in the company's history is going to be right around the turn of the decade when we take one of those microgravity-enabled formulations and we inject it into a human in the clinic," Bruey said. About 70 per cent of Varda's payload customer base for next year is government-based and the rest is commercial pharmaceutical work, Bruey said. He expects that proportion to gradually flip by 2032, underscoring the company's bet on pharmaceuticals. The company in August appointed biotechnology executive and Pfizer veteran Mikael Dolsten to its board, and about 18 per cent of Varda's some 275 employees have pharmaceutical backgrounds, Asparouhov said. Roughly the size of a dishwasher, the company's latest pods can orbit Earth for days, then re-enter the atmosphere at some 25 times the speed of sound, with the re-entry itself offering hypersonic research capabilities for the Pentagon. Varda faces competition from SpaceX's Starfall program that debuted this year, as well as startup Inversion Space in a nascent point-to-point transportation market, where the Pentagon sees orbital space as a swift highway for shuttling military cargo anywhere in the world in roughly an hour. The business of manufacturing things in space has grown as the 2030 retirement of the International Space Station approaches. That 26-year-old orbital laboratory, managed by a group of space powers, has been a key platform for space manufacturing research in areas ranging from artificial organ growth to fiber optic cables.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Facing climate lawsuits, Big Oil again turns to US Supreme Court
item.description: Facing potential liability for harms related to climate change, major oil companies have again turned to the US Supreme Court, teeing up a case that could determine the fate of dozens of climate-related lawsuits by state and local governments against fossil fuel companies.
item.dc:creator: John Kruzel
item.content:encoded: Facing potential liability for harms related to climate change, major oil companies have again turned to the US Supreme Court , [USN:S0N3V202A TEXT:"teeing up a case"] that could determine the fate of dozens of climate-related lawsuits by state and local governments against fossil fuel companies. The dispute involves a bid by ExxonMobil (XOM.N) and Suncor Energy (SU.TO) to scuttle a lawsuit brought by officials in Boulder, Colorado, seeking to hold the companies liable for helping drive climate change and misleading the public about the risks of fossil fuels. The case will be argued next Monday on the first day of the court's new nine-month term. It marks the latest example of energy-sector companies asking the justices to block climate-related liability or limit federal environmental regulation. Nearly 60 state and local governments have brought similar suits seeking billions of dollars from fossil fuel companies, with more continuing to be filed, Exxon and Suncor told the justices. A ruling by the top US judicial body in favor of the companies could lead to many of those cases being dismissed. President Donald Trump 's administration has backed Exxon and Suncor, arguing that federal law precludes Boulder's claims. "The stakes are enormous here. There are billions of damages that are sought," attorney Deepak Gupta, who regularly argues before the Supreme Court, said during a Georgetown Law preview of the court's new term. "And the underlying subject here is maybe the most consequential thing we could be litigating." Backers of the oil companies argue that if Boulder's most far-reaching claims are allowed to proceed, it could give states sweeping power over conduct occurring far outside their borders. Saikrishna Prakash, a University of Virginia law professor who filed a brief supporting the companies, said the implications would reach well beyond Exxon and Suncor. "If Boulder can attach liability to these two companies, I think it can attach liability to thousands of others as well," Prakash said during a preview of the case hosted by George Mason University's Antonin Scalia Law School. "Essentially, Boulder claims that Colorado can reach around the United States (and) regulate production everywhere by attaching liability to it." INDUSTRY TRACK RECORD Energy companies and trade groups, along with states allied with them, have built a largely winning record before the justices over the past two decades in cases involving climate liability and the reach of federal environmental regulation. One key setback for them came in a 2007 ruling, however, when the court ruled that greenhouse gases qualify as air pollutants under the Clean Air Act, a landmark federal anti-pollution law, and that the Environmental Protection Agency has authority to regulate them. The burning of fossil fuels releases greenhouse gases including carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, trapping heat and raising average global temperatures over time. The energy sector gained a major victory in 2011 when the Supreme Court blocked states and environmental groups from suing under federal law to seek court-ordered reductions in carbon emissions from power companies. Climate plaintiffs responded by turning to lawsuits brought under state laws. Oil companies repeatedly have asked the Supreme Court to block or redirect a growing wave of state-law climate suits. In a 2021 [USN:L2N2N417V TEXT:"ruling"] involving Baltimore, the court sided with BP (BP.L) , Chevron (CVX.N) , Exxon and other energy companies on a procedural issue governing appeals over whether climate cases belong in state or federal court. The decision aided companies seeking to move such cases into federal court, generally viewed as a more favorable venue for them. That procedural issue first brought the Boulder case to the Supreme Court in 2023, when it left in place a lower court's ruling returning the lawsuit to state court. Justice Samuel Alito took no part in consideration of the case at that time and [USN:L1N45K0QH TEXT:"has recused"] from participating in the current dispute. Alito owns stock in several oil and gas companies but not Exxon or Suncor, according to his financial disclosure forms. MONETARY DAMAGES SOUGHT The Boulder case involves whether federal law precludes certain state-law claims seeking damages for harms allegedly caused by the effects of greenhouse gas emissions. The justices also directed the parties to address whether the court has jurisdiction to decide the case at this stage. Boulder's city and county governments sued Exxon and Suncor in 2018, accusing them of misleading the public about the climatic effects of fossil fuels while continuing to promote and sell their products. The companies deny wrongdoing. The plaintiffs seek unspecified monetary damages to help cover past and future costs associated with climate change, including infrastructure repairs, environmental damage, emergency management and harms to public health. "Local communities are living with the mounting costs of climate change," Aaron Brockett, mayor of the city of Boulder, said after the court announced it would hear the case. "The Supreme Court should affirm Colorado's right to hold these companies accountable for the harm they have caused in Colorado." The companies urged lower courts to dismiss the case, arguing among other things that Boulder's claims intrude on an area governed by federal law and the Clean Air Act. The Colorado Supreme Court rejected these arguments last year, prompting the companies to appeal to the US Supreme Court.

item.title: Wall St regulator unveils new retail investor proposals for private assets
item.description: The US securities regulator proposed new regulations on Wednesday aimed at expanding access to private assets that have traditionally been reserved for professionals, potentially offering higher returns but also exposing everyday Americans to more risk.
item.dc:creator: Douglas Gillison, Suzanne McGee
item.content:encoded: The US securities regulator proposed new regulations on Wednesday aimed at expanding [USN:L4N40I15I TEXT:"access to private assets"] that have traditionally been reserved for professionals, potentially offering higher returns but also exposing everyday Americans to more risk. The Securities and Exchange Commission's proposals are part of a broader push by the Trump administration to "democratize" private assets, such as private equity, private credit, real estate and venture capital that can potentially result in higher returns than traditional stock and bond portfolios. This included enabling potentially hundreds of thousands of certified professionals, such as accountants, financial analysts and planners and licensed research analysts to access private investments as so-called accredited investors, a status that currently requires wealth and income tests or holding accredited professions such as being a broker-dealer. Critics say the effort is a boon for Wall Street, coming at the expense of retail investors who may not understand the fees involved or risks of such assets, which are often hard to price and cannot be immediately redeemed for cash. "As I've said repeatedly, exposure to the full dynamism of our markets should not be reserved for the wealthiest or for those who are deemed to be the most sophisticated," SEC Chair Paul Atkins said at a public meeting. "Private market investments, like any investments, are not without risks. But the mere presence of investment risk is not grounds to exclude individual investors in perpetuity." Analysts' views differ as to the extent to which private investments typically outperform the stock market, however. The three-member SEC, which currently has no Democratic commissioners, proposed changes to so-called performance fees for investment advisers and share redemptions at "closed-end" funds. It also issued five separate notices that it is considering allowing accountants, chartered financial analysts, certified financial planners, investment banking license holders and licensed research analysts to qualify as accredited investors. "For too long, the accredited investor definition has focused on income and wealth as a stand-in for sophistication, and that choice has shut out many Americans who understand investing well, but have not yet built up a large personal balance sheet or income statement," said Republican SEC Commissioner Mark Uyeda. If adopted, the changes would give asset managers more freedom to charge performance fees based on their clients' capital gains, a change SEC officials say would encourage such advisers to offer retail investors access to funds holding private assets where compensation is structured this way. Currently, investment advisers can only charge performance fees to "qualified" clients with a net worth or portfolio assets that surpass certain thresholds. Several financial advisers told Reuters that such changes could create a perverse incentive to expose clients to greater risk. "An adviser paid a share of gains has a reason to reach for risk, so I'd want strong valuation policies and informed client consent," said Jeff Judge of Chesapeake Financial Planners. The second proposal would allow closed-end funds — investment companies that raise fixed amounts of capital — to redeem investor shares on a monthly basis and offer more classes of shares. Susan Ali, an attorney in the commission's investment management division, said the change would boost liquidity for shareholders. A regulatory advisory committee last year said such moves would give retail investors better access to private assets. The changes are subject to public notice and comment before any decision on whether to adopt them.

item.description: ［東京 ３０日 ロイター］ - 城内実経済財政相は３０日、経済財政諮問会議後の会見で、日銀と経済・物価で大きな認識の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日銀と経済・物価で大きな認識の齟齬あると考えていない＝城内経財相 9/30 19:01 配信

城内実経済財政相。2026年9月17日撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

［東京　３０日　ロイター］ - 城内実経済財政相は３０日、経済財政諮問会議後の会見で、日銀と経済・物価で大きな認識の齟齬があると考えていないと述べた。

植田和男日銀総裁が基調的な物価上昇率が物価目標の２％に近付いているとの認識を示したことに対して、政府側の見解を問われて答えた。

城内経済財政相は７月の諮問会議を受けて金融市場関係者とのヒヤリングを実施し、財政の信認を高めるためには潜在成長率の底上げが重要で、成長戦略のモニタリングが重要などの意見があったと紹介した。

高市早苗首相は、３０日の諮問会議で民間議員から長期金利の上昇について様々な意見が出たとし、「責任ある積極財政のもとでの強い経済の実現と、財政の持続可能性の確保を両立する経済財政運営の道筋をより一層明らかにしていく」と語った。

民間議員らはこの日の諮問会議の提言で「中長期の予想物価上昇率が２％程度に安定することが重要であり、日本銀行の通貨及び金融の調節における自主性を尊重しつつ、政府と日本銀行は経済・物価情勢について認識を共有し、それぞれの役割の下で緊密に連携していくべき」と指摘した。

item.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq advance as soft inflation tempers Fed rate-hike bets
item.description: The Nasdaq jumped more than 1% on Wednesday, leading gains among Wall Street's main indexes, as a softer-than-anticipated inflation reading buoyed hopes that the Federal Reserve might not hike rates as soon as next month.
item.dc:creator: Shashwat Chauhan, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: The Nasdaq jumped more than 1% on Wednesday, leading gains among Wall Street's main indexes, as a softer-than-anticipated inflation reading buoyed hopes that the Federal Reserve might not hike rates as soon as next month. A Commerce Department [USN:AQN2MLK4D TEXT:"report"] showed the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index stood at 3.4% on an annual basis in August against estimates of 3.7%, per economists polled by Reuters. Separately, second-quarter [USN:L1N45L0XU TEXT:"GDP data"] showed that the US economy grew at a solid clip. "The PCE report today was under a microscope as participants try to get a handle on how aggressive the Fed needs to be with future rate increases," said Steve Wyett, chief investment strategist at BOK Financial. Traders now see a roughly 38% chance of an October hike, compared to a more than 50% chance seen one day prior, according to the CME FedWatch Tool. Barclays analysts also noted that recent [USN:L1N4310PD TEXT:"methodology changes"] in calculating PCE by the Bureau of Economic Analysis also contributed to a lower reading. Most megacap and growth stocks ticked higher, with Amazon.com (AMZN.O) and Apple (AAPL.O) up around 2% each, while Alphabet (GOOGL.O) advanced 3%. Software stocks were some of the best performers, with Palo Alto Networks (PANW.O) up 3.7%, Microsoft (MSFT.O) gaining 1.9% and Intuit (INTU.O) adding 2.6%. On the other hand, chip stocks weakened, with Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) and Broadcom (AVGO.O) falling nearly 1% each. At 11:49 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) fell 29.41 points, or 0.06%, to 51,320.51, the S&P 500 (.SPX) gained 44.99 points, or 0.59%, to 7,715.83 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) gained 285.41 points, or 1.07%, to 27,082.95. Five of the 11 S&P 500 sectors were trading higher, with information technology (.SPLRCT) and energy (.SPNY) leading gains. Real estate (.SPLRCR) and financials (.SPSY) were the laggards. Comments from at least four Fed officials, including Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari, are due later in the day. CHOPPY SEPTEMBER COMING TO A CLOSE Despite weakness in September, driven by bond market volatility and elevated oil prices amid the US-Iran conflict, the benchmark S&P 500 (.SPX) and the Nasdaq (.IXIC) were on pace for a second straight quarterly advance, if gains hold. The blue-chip index Dow (.DJI) differed, set for a quarterly fall and on track for its first monthly decline since March. On Wednesday, the yield on the 10-year Treasury bond held close to its highest level since June 2007. Crude oil prices rose, with the December contract for Brent crude futures moving higher. Warnings from leaders of the [USN:L6N45612N TEXT:"biggest AI companies"] earlier this month about the potential existential risks from the technology had also rattled the AI trade. The next test for AI appetite could be memory-chip giant Micron Technology's (MU.O) earnings due after the bell. Among other movers, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE.N) climbed 5.9% after the AI server maker [USN:L4N45M0X1 TEXT:"raised"] its long-term revenue growth forecast for its networking business and announced a $1.2 billion deal with Vultr. Moderna (MRNA.O) dropped 7.2% after brokerage Citigroup downgraded its rating on the biotech company to "sell" from "neutral". Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.01-to-1 ratio on the NYSE and by a 1.14-to-1 ratio on the Nasdaq. The S&P 500 posted 9 new 52-week highs and 18 new lows while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 38 new highs and 136 new lows.

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝堅調、四半期では中国株4年ぶり大幅安 景気支援策が期待外れ
item.description:
Jiaxing Li Tom Westbrook
[香港／シンガポール ３０日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は堅調。た...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝堅調、四半期では中国株4年ぶり大幅安　景気支援策が期待外れ 9/30 18:47 配信

Jiaxing Li　Tom Westbrook

[香港／シンガポール ３０日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は堅調。ただ、優良株指数は１年ぶりの安値付近で推移した。中国政府が発表した新たな景気支援策は弱気の投資家を失望させた。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は０．３％上昇したものの、今週付けた１年ぶりの安値から抜け出すのに苦しんでいる。同指数は第３・四半期に１２．５％下落し、２０２２年の新型コロナウイルス流行に伴うロックダウン期以来最大の下落率となった。

上海総合指数も０．３％高。ただ、四半期ベースでは６．１％の下落となり、これも４年ぶりの大幅安。

深セン・ドラゴン・パシフィック・キャピタル・マネジメントのチャールズ・ワン会長は「政策の方向性は正しい。しかし、政府は強力な景気刺激策を手控えており、打ち出された措置は不十分だ」と指摘。「経済は非常に弱く、不動産や消費に回復の兆しは見られない」と述べた。

ハイテク株も軟調に推移し、ＣＳＩ半導体指数は３％近く下落し、６月以降で３３％の下落となった。ＣＳＩ・ＡＩ（人工知能）指数は１．６％下落し、四半期で２６％の下落を記録した。

香港ではハンセン指数が０．４％高となった。

item.title: 豪プライベートクレジット大手、一部解約停止 決算巡り監査法人が疑義
item.description:
Christine Chen Scott Murdoch
[シドニー ３０日 ロイター] - オーストラリアのプライベ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
豪プライベートクレジット大手、一部解約停止　決算巡り監査法人が疑義 9/30 18:45 配信

2016年5月4日、豪シドニーの景色。 REUTERS/Jason Reed

Christine Chen　Scott Murdoch

[シドニー ３０日 ロイター] - オーストラリアのプライベートクレジット大手メトリクス・クレジット・パートナーズは、一部ファンドで解約を停止し、上場するファンド３本の通期決算の公表を延期した。

メトリクスは約４００億豪ドル（２８０億米ドル）を運用する。オーストラリア証券取引所（ＡＳＸ）に上場するメトリクス・リアル・エステート・マルチストラテジー・ファンド、メトリクス・インカム・オポチュニティーズ・トラスト、メトリクス・マスター・インカム・トラストは、メトリクスが資産評価額を引き下げたと公表したことを受け、２８日から取引が停止されている。

メトリクスは３０日、上場する３本のファンドの通期決算について、監査を担当するＫＰＭＧが非上場の商業用不動産へのエクイティ投資の公正価値の算定方法に疑義を示しており９月３０日の提出期限までに監査を完了できないと明らかにした。上場ファンドの投資先となる非上場ファンドの解約を一時停止したと述べた。

同国では、不動産開発会社バスラ・グループの経営破綻を受け、プライベートクレジットに対し不安が広がっている。

バスラ・グループは８月に管財人の管理下に入った時点で、約４０の貸し手に対し３４億豪ドルの債務を抱えていた。その大半はプライベートクレジット会社で、一部はその後、解約受け付けを停止した。 メトリクスは今週、バスラへの投融資はないと説明した。

オーストラリア証券投資委員会（ＡＳＩＣ）は、最近の市場の混乱を踏まえ、国内のプライベートクレジット業界全体の動向を注視していると表明した。同委員会の報道官は、企業名には言及せず、「解約請求を制限または延期する場合、各社は投資家の最善の利益に沿って意思決定を行うべきだ」と述べた。解約する投資家と投資を継続する投資家を公平に扱う必要があるとも指摘した。

格付け会社Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルは、格付けを付与しているメトリクスのホールセールファンド４本を「クレジットウオッチ」に指定したと明らかにした。メトリクスが運用資産全体で講じる措置を監視することを意味する。

item.title: 日銀の自主性尊重、経済財政のリスク説明し信認確保＝諮問会議議員
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 ３０日 ロイター］ - 政府が３０日開いた経済財政諮問会議では、民間議員...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日銀の自主性尊重、経済財政のリスク説明し信認確保＝諮問会議議員 9/30 18:42 配信

2026年6月15日、都内の日銀本店。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon/File Photo

Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　３０日　ロイター］ - 政府が３０日開いた経済財政諮問会議では、民間議員が提言の中で、金融政策運営で日銀の自主性を尊重する考えを示した。金利上昇に関しては、企業や家計、財政への影響を丁寧にみていく必要があるとし、経済財政運営の前提やリスクを説明し、市場の信認を確保することが重要だとした。

民間議員らは提言で「中長期の予想物価上昇率が２％程度に安定することが重要であり、日本銀行の通貨及び金融の調節における自主性を尊重しつつ、政府と日本銀行は経済・物価情勢について認識を共有し、それぞれの役割の下で緊密に連携していくべき」と指摘した。

前回マクロ経済運営を議論した５月の会議の提言では「日本銀行には、期待を含めた物価変動を注視しつつ、市場における各種の資金需給動向にも配慮した、適切な金融政策の実施を期待」と明記していた。

長期金利の変動については、日本の基礎的財政収支が主要国で最も改善していると指摘、財政収支の動向のみで説明できないとした。２４年以降の長期金利上昇は、国内外の経済・物価情勢、金融政策、国債需給などの様々な要因によって変動しているとの認識を示した。

そのうえで、年末に向けた予算編成過程で通年の国債発行額や市中発行額を含む財政全体の姿を明らかにし、経済財政運営の前提やリスクについて透明性の高い説明を行うことで、市場の信認を確保することが重要だとした。

また、物価高対策として「飲食料品消費税率の引き下げ、就業者負担軽減支援金、現役世代の保険料率負担軽減に向けた社会保障改革など、予算編成に向けた検討を進めるべき」と強調。「その際、これまで繰り返してきた一時的な物価高対策については必要性を精査し、所得の持続的な向上や負担構造の見直しへと政策の重点を移すべき」とし、ガソリンや電力・ガス補助金の見直しに含みを持たせた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：日米欧9月同時利上げ、浮き彫りになった「日銀の弱点」＝上野泰也氏 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 コラム：サービス価格上昇に加速の気配、日銀の緩和修正判断に影響も コラム：財政拡張と円安は「日本売り」の予兆か＝内田稔氏 コラム：サナエノミクスが抱える物価高リスクを考える＝熊野英生氏 最終更新: 9/30(水) 18:42 ロイター

item.title: UK links Iran to suspected plot outside airbase used by US bombers
item.description: Britain has "strong indications" that Iran was involved in a suspected plot against a British airbase used by US forces to strike Iran, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain has "strong indications" that Iran was involved in a [USN:L1N45K087 TEXT:"suspected plot"] against a British airbase used by US forces to strike Iran, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Wednesday. In an incident which triggered a huge police response, raised alarm among Western allies, and remains largely unexplained, five British men in their 20s were arrested on Sunday on suspected terrorism and explosive offences near RAF Fairford in western England. The five, who all live in London, were later released on bail. "There are strong indications that Iran played a part in what happened over the weekend at RAF Fairford, but of course it remains an ongoing, complex, and serious police investigation," Burnham told the BBC in an interview. On Monday, Iran strongly denied any involvement, responding to reports that it could be involved in the incident. Burnham said Britain was working closely with the US, whose bombers have in recent months used the base to launch missions against Iran. Shortly after the arrests, President Donald Trump said the men had planned "big damage" and his Secretary of State Marco Rubio later pointed at "a foreign actor". Until Burnham's remarks, Britain had not linked the incident to Iran, though counter-terrorism police have said their investigation included the possibility of foreign state involvement and whether the incident could involve proxies "knowingly or unknowingly working on behalf of a foreign state". ONE SUSPECT CALLED POLICE BEFORE ARREST, REPORT SAYS Police said on Tuesday that [USN:L8N45L1Y5 TEXT:"petrol was found"] in the vans used by the men but no improvised explosive device. Police also defended their decision to release the men on bail, which had been criticised by some, including Trump. Adding to the intrigue around Sunday's events, The Times reported that one of the men called emergency services shortly before being arrested in the early hours. "Whether it was surveillance, a 'dry run' to test security or a stunt to send a message to the British government are all under consideration," The Times said, adding that investigators were unsure whether he got cold feet or it was part of a plan. The newspaper did not cite its sources. Police declined to comment on whether one of the suspects had made the call.

European payments groups join forces to challenge US dominance

FAST

MADRID/PARIS/MILAN, Sept 30 : European payment groups serving 130 million people, including Spain's Bizum, Italy's Bancomat and Brussels-based Wero, said on Wednesday they were joining forces to create a cross-border payments network as Europe seeks to curb its dependence on Visa and Mastercard. The companies will form a new joint venture, the European Network for Payments, which will be based in Madrid and connect national payment systems. European policymakers have made payments sovereignty a priority as a fragmenting global order raises concerns over access to critical payments systems. ENP's founders are Bancomat, Bizum, EPI Company/Wero, SIBS-MB WAY and Vipps MobilePay, which together serve around 130 million users across 13 European countries, covering more than 70 per cent of the population of the EU and Norway.

The network will connect existing payment systems through a common technical and operational layer based on European standards and instant account-to-account payments. The payments group said European Central Bank plans for a digital euro by 2029, essentially an online wallet guaranteed by the ECB but operated by private companies including banks, could eventually complement their project. Fragmentation has long been the "biggest hurdle" for European payment schemes, said Martina Weimert, CEO of the European Payments Initiative. Fernando Rodriguez, deputy general manager for international expansion at Bizum, said ENP had already selected a new CEO and was planning to recruit staff. Shareholders will need to absorb operating costs in the early years as the company builds infrastructure to achieve sufficient scale to generate its own fees, Weimert said. Other European payment schemes could join in the future, the companies said, adding that a phased rollout will begin with cross-border person-to-person payments, followed by e-commerce and point-of-sale transactions. "The creation of the European Network for Payments reflects a growing focus on connecting the payment systems Europeans already use, rather than replacing them," said Marcel Hörauf, a partner at law firm Mayer Brown. Hörauf said that whether this will translate into meaningful EU payment sovereignty depends on how Europe's payment regulations develop, whether it gets accepted by merchants and whether it has political support from EU member states.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 独失業者数、9月1.2万人増で予想大幅に上回る 失業率横ばい
item.description: [ベルリン ３０日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦雇用庁が３０日発表した９月の雇用統計によると、季節調整後の失業者数は前...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
独失業者数、9月1.2万人増で予想大幅に上回る　失業率横ばい 9/30 18:01 配信

2009年1月29日、ミュンヘンの就職支援センター前を歩く男性。REUTERS/Michaela Rehle

[ベルリン ３０日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦雇用庁が３０日発表した９月の雇用統計によると、季節調整後の失業者数は前月比１万２０００人増の３０１万人となった。増加幅はロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想の１０００人増を大幅に上回った。

季節調整後の失業率は６．４％で横ばいだった。

季節調整前の失業者数は２カ月連続で３００万人を超えていたが、９月はこの水準をわずかに下回った。

雇用庁のナーレス長官は声明で、ドイツの労働市場は例年９月から秋の回復期に入るものの、今年は出足が鈍いと指摘した。「景気の改善はまだ労働市場に及んでいない」と述べた。

ＩＮＧのグローバル・マクロ責任者、カーステン・ブルツェスキ氏は労働市場の先行きについて、循環的な安定化が進む可能性を指摘。一方で「構造的トレンドは続くだろう」とし、自動車業界でのコスト削減策や高水準の企業倒産件数を懸念材料に挙げた。

同日発表された８月の小売売上高は前月比１．３％増で市場予想の１．５％増を下回った。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：終わらぬデフレ時代、スーパー業界で価格競争激化　強まる節約志向 焦点：生活費高騰にあえぐイラン市民、戦争７カ月で困窮拡大 アングル：年初来安値圏のユーロ、今後の鍵はエネルギー価格と高まる政治リスク アングル：ネタニヤフ氏、旧来の選挙戦術で「守護者」演出　ハマス攻撃で信頼回復に苦戦も コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず 最終更新: 9/30(水) 18:59 ロイター

item.title: テルアビブ便で副操縦士が機長刺し墜落図る、乗客が制圧＝イスラエル首相
item.description:
Alexander Cornwell Rami Amichay
[エルサレム ３０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Alexander Cornwell　Rami Amichay

[エルサレム ３０日 ロイター] - イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は３０日、アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のドバイからイスラエルのテルアビブに向かっていたフライドバイのＦＺ１０７３便で、副操縦士が機長を刺した後、機体を墜落させようとしたと明らかにした。乗客が副操縦士を取り押さえ、他の操縦士らがサウジアラビアのタブーク空港に無事着陸させたという。

ネタニヤフ氏は、この事件を「極めて深刻な安全保障上の事件」と表現し、サウジ当局が副操縦士を取り調べると述べた。襲撃したとされる副操縦士は着陸後に逮捕された。イスラエル当局者の１人は、副操縦士がオマーン国籍だと明らかにした。

イスラエル首相府が公表したビデオ声明でネタニヤフ氏は、乗客はほぼ全員がイスラエル人だったとし、「乗客全員の安全は確保されている」と述べた。また、乗客の話として、機体が「きりもみ状態に陥り、急降下し始めた」後、乗客らが乗務員１人とともに操縦室に押し入り、副操縦士が「機体のシステムを破壊しようとしている」のを発見したと説明。「彼らは多くの命を救い、大惨事を防いだ」と述べた。

別のイスラエル当局者はロイターに対し、操縦士同士が争いになった後、同機が緊急信号を発信したと語っていた。

フライト追跡サイト「フライトレーダー２４」によると、機体のデータでは、最初の緊急信号が発信される前に、３０秒足らずで約１万４０００フィート（約４２００メートル）急降下したことが示されていた。

機体がサウジアラビアに着陸した頃、イスラエル首相府報道官はロイターに、事件はハイジャックではないとみられると説明した。

その後のイスラエル当局者は記者団への説明で、政府は現時点で「テロ攻撃」未遂事件とみており、いずれかの操縦士の精神状態の問題とは関係ないとの見方を示した。

＜タブーク空港、両操縦士とも入院と発表＞

この便に搭乗していたイスラエル人乗客はメディアに対し、操縦士１人が刺され１人が重傷、もう１人は軽傷を負ったと証言した。タブーク空港は、両操縦士がけがを負って入院したと発表した。

フライトレーダー２４によると、同便は一般緊急信号を発信した後、不法干渉の可能性を示す別の緊急信号を発信、その後、再び最初の一般緊急信号を発信した。イスラエルメディアによると、搭乗していたイスラエル人乗客は約１５０人。

イスラエルメディアの報道は錯綜しており、一部は操縦士の１人が自殺を図って旅客機を墜落させようとしたと伝えた。操縦士の国籍について、オマーン人とＵＡＥ人と伝えたメディアもあれば、ロシア人とウクライナ人と報じたメディアもあった。

事件を受け、イスラエルは国家安全保障協議を開いた。ネタニヤフ首相は２７日、ＵＡＥを訪問し、ムハンマド大統領と会談したばかり。両国は２０２０年の国交樹立以来、安全保障、軍事、経済面で緊密な関係を築いてきた。今年に入り、イスラエルはＵＡＥに防空システム「アイアンドーム」を提供、イランからの攻撃への防衛を支援した。

フライドバイはドバイ─テルアビブ便を毎日運航しており、イスラエル人に人気の路線となっている。

item.title: テマセク、リヤドとアブダビに新拠点開設へ 中東で投資機会探る
item.description:
Yantoultra Ngui
[香港 ３０日 ロイター] - シンガポールの政府系投資会社テマセクは３０日、中東全...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
テマセク、リヤドとアブダビに新拠点開設へ　中東で投資機会探る 9/30 17:39 配信

テマセクのロゴ。2022年11月30日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Yantoultra Ngui

[香港 ３０日 ロイター] - シンガポールの政府系投資会社テマセクは３０日、中東全域で投資や提携の機会を探るため、２０２７年上半期にリヤドとアブダビに事務所を開設する計画を発表した。承認が得られることが条件となる。

新事務所の開設により、テマセクの拠点は２７年に世界１１カ国の１５カ所に拡大する。２６年３月３１日時点の保有資産の純ポートフォリオ価値は５１８０億シンガポールドル（４０５５億米ドル）だった。

ディルハン・ピレイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は声明で「中東はテマセクのグローバルネットワークの重要な一角を占める」と述べた。「中東全域で進む経済改革の速さと意欲は目覚ましく、長期的なファンダメンタルズは引き続き非常に魅力的だ」とした。

声明によると、テマセクは中東全域、特にサウジアラビア、アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）、カタールで関係を深める方針で、これらの国では自社と投資先企業にとって長期的な事業機会があるとみている。今回の拠点拡大により、中央アジアやアフリカでも事業機会を捉えやすくなるとした。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず アングル：米企業、金利上昇で借り換え負担増大　コロナ禍調達分の満期相次ぐ コラム：米利上げでアジア株式市場に明暗、経常赤字国の打撃大きく コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 最終更新: 9/30(水) 17:39 ロイター

US dollar retreats after softer-than-expected inflation data

An employee holds U.S. dollar bank notes at a money changer in Jakarta, Indonesia, April 9, 2025. REUTERS/Willy Kurniawan

FAST

NEW YORK, Sept 30 : The dollar retreated against major currencies on Wednesday following data showing a smaller-than-expected increase in US inflation, which reduced market bets on an interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve. US Commerce Department data showed that the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, rose 0.3 per cent last month. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast an increase of 0.4 per cent. The dollar has been strengthening in tandem with rising US Treasury yields on growing expectations of more Fed rate hikes amid inflation driven by higher oil prices. But the dollar pared recent gains against the euro following the data while US Treasury yields fell across the board, with the 2-year note yield, which typically moves in step with Fed rate expectations, down 4.15 basis points to 4.848 per cent.

The euro rose 0.15 per cent to $1.135725. The single currency is still headed for a monthly loss against the dollar after two consecutive months of gains. "We can't tell if the revised PCE data by itself or if other factors were responsible for a softer-than-expected print, which initially caused bonds to rally and yields to come down and the dollar to weaken," said John Velis, FX and macro strategist at BNY.  "We had some strong GDP data: the long end of the yield curve has kind of gone back up and front end is still lower so the curve is steeper. So the 2-year yield has come down to reflect lower expectations of an October rate hike and the dollar has come down in tandem." Traders are now pricing a nearly 35 per cent probability of a Fed rate hike in October, down from 70 per cent a week ago, according to the CME's FedWatch tool. Oil prices rose and were on track for a big monthly gain in September as US-Iran talks aimed at ending their war stalled.  Brent November futures contract, which expires on Wednesday, rose 0.84 per cent, at $103.45 a barrel. The dollar also weakened 0.25 per cent to 156.7987 yen. It was flat at 0.83425 versus the Swiss franc and on track for the second straight month of gains.  Sterling strengthened 0.44 per cent to $1.3287 but was set for a monthly loss against the dollar, ending two consecutive months of gains. The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro,fell 0.20 per cent to 101.20. It is still headed for a monthly gain in September, snapping two straight months of losses.  Elsewhere, the Australian dollar weakened 0.36 per cent versus the greenback to $0.6958, and the kiwi  strengthened 0.07 per cent versus the greenback to $0.5643.

Source: Reuters

Singapore's Temasek to open Riyadh, Abu Dhabi offices in Middle East expansion

The new offices will expand Temasek's global network to 15 offices in 11 countries in 2027.

A view of investment company Temasek's logo at its Singapore headquarters. (File photo: CNA/Abigail Ng)

FAST

HONG KONG: Singapore state investor Temasek said on Wednesday (Sep 30) it planned to open offices in Riyadh and Abu Dhabi in the first half of 2027, subject to approvals, seeking investment and partnership opportunities across the Middle East. The new offices will expand Temasek's global network to 15 offices in 11 countries in 2027. Temasek had a net portfolio value of S$518 billion (US$405.5 billion) as of Mar 31, 2026. "The Middle East is an important part of Temasek’s global network," Temasek CEO Dilhan Pillay Sandrasegara said in a statement. "The pace and ambition of economic transformation across the region are remarkable, and its long-term fundamentals remain highly attractive."

The expansion signals Temasek's confidence in the Gulf's long-term growth despite regional tensions that have raised uncertainty for markets, energy supplies and shipping. The statement said Temasek would deepen engagement across the Middle East, particularly in Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Qatar, where it sees long-term opportunities for itself and its portfolio companies. Temasek said it would also engage institutions in Qatar and other Middle East markets. The expansion would also strengthen its access to opportunities in Central Asia and Africa, it added. Chia Song Hwee, CEO of Temasek Global Investments, became chairman for the Middle East and Africa on Sep 1. He will provide senior oversight of Temasek's engagement and long-term growth in the markets, Temasek said. "Being on the ground in the Middle East will strengthen engagement with our partners and enhance access to investment opportunities for Temasek and our portfolio companies throughout the region and beyond to Central Asia and Africa," Chia said. "Equally, it allows us to bring complementary expertise from across our ecosystem to these markets, expanding pathways to create lasting value with like-minded partners." Ankit Khemka will remain managing director for the region and lead Temasek's strategy and expansion.

item.title: BOJ's policy pivot opens scope for faster rate hikes

BOJ's policy pivot opens scope for faster rate hikes

FILE PHOTO: Traffic signs in front of the Bank of Japan building in Tokyo, Japan, June 15, 2026. REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon/File Photo

30 Sep 2026 04:23PM (Updated: 30 Sep 2026 04:47PM)

FAST

TOKYO, Sept 30 : The Bank of Japan expects interest rate increases to happen faster and more regularly in future as it pre-empts risks of an inflation overshoot, sources said, enhancing the importance of data due this week in gauging the timing of its next move. Any sign of heightening corporate inflation expectations in Thursday's "Tankan" survey or broadening price pressures in Friday's inflation data will likely bolster the case for another rate hike either in October or December. Some market players see chances of an October hike, with threats of intervention failing to lift the yen and putting the onus on the BOJ to underpin the currency with more aggressive monetary tightening. A weak yen pushes up import prices and the broader cost of living for households. Having just raised rates, however, the BOJ will likely set a high hurdle for an October hike, which becomes an option only if external shocks boost risks of an inflation overshoot, said three sources familiar with its thinking.

"While inflation risks exist, there's no clear evidence now pointing to the chance of an abrupt, sharp spike in price growth," said one of them, a view echoed by another source. BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda too has said a back-to-back increase could come only if there was a risk of sharp price rises or if underlying inflation was already above the BOJ's 2 per cent target. But he also stressed the central bank's readiness to act "pre-emptively" to avoid being forced to take extreme steps, a sign the BOJ will no longer spend an inordinate amount of time in between meetings to lift borrowing costs. "Financial conditions remain accommodative, requiring the BOJ to hike steadily as needed," the first source said. "With underlying inflation converging around 2 per cent, the BOJ probably feels the need to speed up a bit," said another source. The BOJ did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The sources spoke on condition of anonymity due to the sensitivity of the matter. Former BOJ board member Makoto Sakurai, who retains close ties with incumbent policymakers, told Reuters he expects the central bank to raise its policy rate — now at 1.25 per cent — to 2 per cent by around June next year. INFLATION EXPECTATIONS KEY Ueda sat tight for a year after taking office in 2023 before exiting a decade-long stimulus. The BOJ then hiked rates once in 2024 and twice in 2025 under a cautious approach focused on downside economic risks. It pivoted to an approach focused on fighting inflation in June, when it raised rates to 1.0 per cent as rising import costs heightened the chance of broad-based price rises. The BOJ kept rates steady in July but stressed its alarm over mounting price pressures, previewing the hike in September. With underlying inflation close to 2 per cent, the BOJ's policy has entered a "new phase" focusing on forestalling inflation risks, Ueda said this month, paving the way for speedier rate hikes. He also said two "very important factors" convinced him that underlying inflation was nearing 2 per cent: rising long-term inflation expectations and steady wage gains. Thursday's Tankan will show whether corporate inflation expectations could heighten from already record levels hit three months ago. Core consumer inflation in Tokyo is likely to have hit 2.4 per cent in September, a Reuters poll showed, accelerating sharply from 1.8 per cent in August, in a sign of broadening price pressures. The data will affect the BOJ's new quarterly forecasts due next month. In current forecasts, it expects nationwide core inflation to hit 2.5 per cent in fiscal 2026 and 2.4 per cent in fiscal 2027. "The key would be how much the BOJ will revise up its fiscal 2027 inflation forecasts ... and how far it could push back the timing for when inflation peaks," said Mari Iwashita, executive rates strategist at Nomura Securities. "That will offer very important messages on the BOJ's rate-hike timing."

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米国株取引、週末も24時間可能に＝オンライン証券ロビンフッド
item.description:
Jayasree Prabhu Manya Saini
[２９日 ロイター] - オンライン証券会社ロビンフッドは２９...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株取引、週末も24時間可能に＝オンライン証券ロビンフッド 9/30 16:58 配信

オンライン証券会社ロビンフッドのロゴ。2021年7月、米ニューヨーク市で撮影。 REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

Jayasree Prabhu　Manya Saini

[２９日 ロイター] - オンライン証券会社ロビンフッドは２９日、週末にも一部の米国株取引を２４時間体制で可能にする方針を示した。

同社は２０２３年から、平日における２４時間取引を可能にしている。この機能の導入から約１０カ月後には、取引が活発な日の総取引高のうち、最大２５％が伝統的な取引時間以外で生じていると発表した。

ロビンフッドが週末の取引を可能にするのは初めて。

伝統的な時間帯以外の流動性が乏しいため、トレーダーが最適な価格で取引できなくなるのではないかと懸念する声もある。それでも、ナスダックやロンドン証券取引所などの世界的な取引所は、取引時間の延長計画を推進している。

ロビンフッドはまず、週末取引向けに厳選された株式および上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）のリストを示す。夜間取引インフラ企業ブルースＡＴＳとの提携により開始されるこの機能は、現在規制当局による審査待ちとなっている。

プロダクトマネジメント担当バイスプレジデントのアビシェク・ファテプリア氏はロイターのインタビューで「今年の当社の焦点は、通常はヘッジファンドやクオンツ、多くの大手アクティブトレーディング企業にのみ提供されていたツールをアクティブトレーダーに提供することで、ロビンフッドをアクティブトレーダーにとって最高の場所にすることだ」と語った。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず アングル：米企業、金利上昇で借り換え負担増大　コロナ禍調達分の満期相次ぐ コラム：米利上げでアジア株式市場に明暗、経常赤字国の打撃大きく コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 最終更新: 9/30(水) 16:58 ロイター

item.title: ロシア軍、キーウ州の発電所やイズマイル港など攻撃＝国防相
item.description:
[モスクワ ３０日 ロイター] - ロシア国防省は３０日、ロシア軍が夜間の大規模攻撃で、ウクライナの首都キーウの通信拠点や、軍需生産を支えるキーウ州のエネルギー施設、イズマイルの港湾施設を攻撃したと発表した。
ロシア側が攻撃したと主張する標的は以下の通り。
• キーウではデノボのデータセンターを攻撃した。ロシア側はウクライナ軍を支える主要なインターネット通信の相互接続拠点だと主張した。
• キーウ州では、ナリワイキウカ近郊のキーウ変電所、ビシホロドのキーウ水力発電所、トリピリスカ火力発電所、ホレニチの蓄電施設を攻撃した。
• ロシア側はこれらの施設がウクライナの軍需産業やキーウとその周辺の軍事施設に電力を供給していたと説明した。
• 南部オデーサ州ではイズマイル港の産業施設を攻撃した。ウクライナ軍向けの軍事物資や燃料の受け入れ、保管、輸送に使われていたという。

item.title: 三菱化工機と月島ＨＤ、株式交換で27年4月に経営統合
item.description: [東京 ３０日 ロイター] - 水処理・産業機械プラントを手がける月島ホールディングスと三菱化工機は３０日、２０２７...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
三菱化工機と月島ＨＤ、株式交換で27年4月に経営統合 9/30 16:42 配信

[東京 ３０日 ロイター] - 水処理・産業機械プラントを手がける月島ホールディングスと三菱化工機は３０日、２０２７年４月１日に経営統合すると発表した。共同持ち株会社「三菱月島化工機ホールディングス」を設立する。

株式交換により、三菱化工機が月島ＨＤの全株を取得し、月島ホールディングスは２７年３月３０日に上場廃止となる予定。株式交換比率は１対０．８８で、月島ホールディングス１株に対し、三菱化工機０．８８株を割り当てる。

経営統合で両社の強みを活かし、機器の開発・設計・製造などのバリューチェーンを強化する。グループ経営目標として３６年３月期に売上高３５００億円、営業利益３００億円以上を目指し、シナジー効果として売上高５００億円、営業利益８０億円の発現を見込むとしている。

月島ＨＤは同時に、発行済み株式の２．５％に当たる１００万株・３０億円を上限とする自社株買いを実施すると発表した。取得期間は１０月５日から２７年３月１９日まで。取得した株式は三菱化工機が月島ＨＤの株式を取得する直前に消却する。

item.title: アングル：終わらぬデフレ時代、スーパー業界で価格競争激化 強まる節約志向
item.description:
Yusuke Ogawa
［東京 ３０日 ロイター］ - 首都圏のスーパーで、「デフレ時代」を思わせる価格競争が激し...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アングル：終わらぬデフレ時代、スーパー業界で価格競争激化　強まる節約志向 9/30 16:40 配信

写真はスーパーマーケットの売り場。2020年5月、千葉で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Yusuke Ogawa

［東京　３０日　ロイター］ - 首都圏のスーパーで、「デフレ時代」を思わせる価格競争が激しさを増している。物価高で消費者の節約志向が強まる一方、ロピアやオーケーなど安さを武器に急成長するディスカウント勢が出店を加速。既存の大手も１円単位の価格競争に引き込まれている。

その象徴が、首都圏を地盤とする老舗のイトーヨーカ堂だ。かつて総合スーパー大手として全国に店舗網を広げたが、衣料品や日用雑貨の専門店との競争などで業績が低迷。昨年９月に親元のセブン＆アイ・ホールディングスを離れ、米投資ファンドのベインキャピタル傘下に入った。再出発したヨーカ堂が巻き返しの柱の一つに据えるのが低価格戦略だ。

低価格プライベートブランド（ＰＢ）の開発を強化し、２０２８年度には同ブランドの売上高を２５年度比で約３倍に引き上げる。「消費者から『高い』というイメージを持たれ、価格に敏感な若いファミリー層を取りこぼしてきた」。ヨーカ堂を運営するヨーク・ホールディングスの石橋誠一郎社長は反省を口にする。

イメージ脱却に向けた目玉商品が、９月に発売した低価格ＰＢ「セブン・ザ・プライス」のラガービールだ。ヨーカ堂がＰＢビールを開発するのは今回が初めて。ベトナムの工場に生産を委託してコストを抑え、ナショナルブランド（ＮＢ）商品より約２割安い１本１７３円（３３０ミリリットル）で販売する。１０月の酒税改正後には１６２円に設定し、特売時には６本入りパックで１本当たり約１４６円まで引き下げる予定だという。

ヨーカ堂だけではない。ライバルの業界最大手イオンは、昨年の類似商品と比べて価格を約３分の１に抑えた税別１０００円のフリースを投入する。前回の発売は２００１年で、当時ブームを起こしていた「ユニクロ」に対抗して企画した。今月には格安ジーンズ（税別１０００円）を約１７年ぶりに発売。広報担当者は「非常に反響が大きく、早くもほぼ完売の状態になっている」と話す。

＜インフレ下で安売り回帰＞

日本経済がインフレ局面に入ったにもかかわらず、なぜスーパーの現場では「デフレ時代」のような安売り競争が復活しているのか。背景にあるのは、賃金も伸びるが物価も上昇し、消費者の生活防衛意識が強まっていることだ。

総務省の家計調査によると、７月の２人以上世帯の消費支出は３０万１２４５円で、物価変動の影響を除いた実質では前年同月比３．６％減った。減少は８カ月連続。食料も実質１．３％減と２カ月連続で前年を下回った。

日本チェーンストア協会がまとめた８月の全国スーパー売上高は、既存店ベースで前年同月比０．２％増にとどまった。客数は前年割れで、食品値上げによる客単価の上昇がかろうじて販売額を押し上げている。富裕層やインバウンド（訪日客）の旺盛な消費に支えられ、好調を維持する百貨店とは対照的だ。

値上げ圧力もなお強い。帝国データバンクによると、円安やイラン紛争の影響で９月の飲食料品値上げは４９２３品目に達し、単月としては２３年４月以来の高水準となった。１０月も約３１００品目の値上げが予定されており、２６年の対象商品は現時点までの判明分だけで２万品目を超える。

今秋には電気・ガス代の上昇も見込まれ、実質賃金が再びマイナスに転じる可能性もある。みずほ総合研究所の池田亮平氏は「インフレの再燃により家計の節約志向・買い控え行動が一段と強まりかねない」と指摘する。

モノの値段が上がり続ける一方、売り場では安値を競う。この「インフレ下の安売り競争」への危機感は、低価格ＰＢ「ベストプライス」を大量に展開するイオンよりヨーカ堂のほうが強い。

ヨークＨＤの高倉和也シニアオフィサーは「食料品は真っ先に節約の対象になりやすい。だが当社は低価格ＰＢの品ぞろえが少なく、売り場で十分に面展開ができない」と打ち明ける。

セブン＆アイのＰＢはコンビニ向けの「セブンプレミアム」が主力で、セブン・ザ・プライスは約３００品目にとどまる。今後はマヨネーズなどの加工食品を中心に開発を加速し、「年間で億円単位の売上を作れるような『戦える商品』をそろえたい」（高倉氏）という。

＜新勢力「ＬＯＴ」が台頭＞

業界を価格競争へと駆り立てるもう一つの要因が、首都圏で存在感を増す「ＬＯＴ」だ。ディスカウントスーパーの「ロピア」「オーケー」「トライアル」の頭文字を組み合わせた造語で、いずれも無駄を徹底的に省くローコスト経営で低価格を実現し、価格に敏感な消費者の支持を集めている。

とりわけ福岡県に本社を置くトライアルホールディングスは、大手スーパーの西友を昨年買収し、攻勢を強めている。人口が増加する都内での需要開拓に向け、コンビニサイズの小型スーパー「ＴＲＩＡＬ ＧＯ」の出店も始めた。

ドン・キホーテを展開するパン・パシフィック・インターナショナルホールディングス（ＰＰＩＨ）は今年７月、首都圏地盤のスーパー、Ｏｌｙｍｐｉｃグループを買収。食品を強化した新業態「ロビン・フッド」への転換に乗り出した。今後は「ドンキや傘下のスーパー、ユニーの調達網を活用して、安さを一段と訴求していく方針」（ＰＰＩＨ）という。

さらに、ローソンが５月に東京都内で、コンビニより割安な商品をそろえた小型スーパーの１号店を開業するなど、業態の垣根を越えた価格競争も激しくなっている。

＜薄利競争、再編圧力に＞

ただ人件費や物流費の上昇が業績の重荷になる中で、低価格競争を勝ち抜くのは容易ではない。収益悪化懸念などから、イオンの株価は年初と比べて約半分の水準にまで落ち込んでいる。スーパー各社はＩＴ技術を活用して店舗運営の効率化に取り組んでいるが、為替の円安基調も相まって食品高騰が続けば、「規模の利」を求めて業界の合従連衡がさらに進む可能性がある。

ヨークＨＤの石橋社長は「国内のスーパー業界は大手１０社を合計しても２割程度のシェアしかない」と指摘。採算を確保するために「最終的には、大手のシェアが過半に達する水準」にまで集約を進める必要があるとの考えを示した。

（小川悠介　編集：久保信博）
